en.name: Visual Novel
en.description: New Capybara, 1933. Private investigator Sam Malone and his assistant, Tommy, take on a case to find a missing wooden leg that contains a secret ledger. A branching noir detective story infused with dark humor, where any choice could be your last.

games.name: Chisel Me This
games.description: 『Chisel Me This』は、友達と一緒にお題に沿った彫刻を作り、出来栄えを競い合う1～8人プレイ対応のパーティーゲームです。巨大な大理石の塊を彫ったり、粘土をこねたり、作品を作りながらライバルの邪魔をしたりして、みんなでワイワイ楽しもう！

en.name: Chisel Me This
en.description: Chisel Me This is a 1-8 player party game where you and your friends compete to create statues of various prompts. Sculpt large marble blocks, mold clay, and sabotage competitors as you create artistic masterpieces!

games.name: DEEPLANDERS
games.description: DEEPLANDERS は、地下の奥深くに人々を住まわせ、光をもたらすことをテーマにした、ミニマルな建築とパズルのゲームです。居心地のよい地下都市を築き、それぞれの Deeplander が調和して暮らせる最適な場所を見つけましょう。

en.name: DEEPLANDERS
en.description: DEEPLANDERS is a minimalist construction puzzle game about populating the depths and bringing light into them. Build cozy underground cities and find the perfect place for each Deeplander to live in harmony.

games.name: Lingering Torment
games.description: Explore an abandoned house with seemingly no exit, as you quickly uncover the terror that resides hidden beneath the walls...

en.name: Lingering Torment

en.name: AlterMage

en.name: Stealing Christmas

games.name: Tavern Clicker
games.description: このシンプルなクリッカーゲームで、居心地のよい中世の酒場を経営しよう。個性豊かなお客さんをもてなし、新しい飲み物をアンロックして、仕事を自動化。小さな酒場を王様にふさわしい場所へと育てよう！

en.name: Tavern Clicker
en.description: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

games.name: 魔王のメイドカフェ
games.description: 注文をお願い、ブラザー！『魔王のメイドカフェ』は、メイドカフェでスライムたちにサービスを提供する、とテーマにした短編のインクリメンタルゲームです。アップグレードを購入して、メイドカフェを頂点へと導きましょう。

trailers.name: The Demon Lord's Maid Cafe Gameplay Trailer

en.description: Take my order, brother! The Demon Lord's Maid Cafe is a short cafe-themed incremental game about feeding slimes in a Maid Cafe. Buy upgrades, feed slimes, and take your Maid Cafe to the top.

games.name: Birzaビルザ
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
games.description: デスクトップ放置型バードウォッチングシシミュレーター。小鳥の餌やりや世話の心配は不要です。デスクトップの片隅に置いておくだけで、様々な可愛い小鳥が自ら訪れます。プレイヤーは以下のことが可能です：放置で獲得コイン‌：エサを購入して小鳥にあげる ‌カメラ機能‌：鳥たちの愛らしい瞬間を撮影。オリジナルノート作成‌：種類ごとの観察記録をカスタム。 ‌コレクション要素‌：希少な鳥や自然景観のアンロック。

en.name: Birza
en.description: A desktop birding simulator.Here, you won't need to worry about feeding or raising the birds.Simply leave it running quietly on your desktop, and adorable birds will visit on their own.You can purchase food and feed them.Use the camera to capture their cute moments.Create personalized birding books.

games.name: TBS: TASK BAR SURVIVOR

en.name: TBS: TASK BAR SURVIVOR
en.description: A relaxing pixel-art desktop survivor where a lone samurai grows stronger while you work or chill. Stack and merge weapon boxes into a growing arsenal, unlock upgrades, shape your build, and face powerful bosses to calm Japanese-inspired music.

en.name: Dino Slug
en.description: Dive into an action-packed, hand-drawn top-down shooter. Explore a dark jungle and fight the lurking soldiers of a totalitarian regime and, of course: dinos! Numerous weapons, grenades, and items make mercenary life a bit easier! 90s retro fun guaranteed.

games.name: Dusteroids

en.description: Build a team of gotchimon, pick their moves and fighting order, then watch them battle on their own. Play the story campaign, take on other players' teams in the PvP Arena, and keep a run going in a small corner window while you work.

en.name: Berry Busy Tidy Up!
en.description: A delivery hit the market of Elderberry Vale and went everywhere. Now thousands of fruits need a home. Carry them to the right stall and line them up in perfect rows, alone or with up to two friends in online co-op. No timers, no fail states, just one very satisfying mess.

en.name: Windowed Realms

games.name: デスクトップにゃんにゃんタワー
games.shortName: デスクトップにゃんにゃんタワー

en.name: Desktop Cozy Cat Tree
en.description: Build a cat tree right on your desktop. Cats climb the post, leap from the top and bounce off the rides you place, earning gold with every hit. Arrange rides, meet a growing crew of cats and decorate your Cat House in a cozy idle game that plays quietly beside your work.

games.name: Tool Land

en.name: Tool Land
en.description: Tool Land is an exploration-adventure puzzle platformer. Collect tools that each work differently and uncover the secrets between their mechanics. Explore this rough-looking world freely and solve a variety of puzzles.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Spooky Carnival
genres: クリーチャーコレクター

trailers.name: Hidden Cats in Spooky Carnival Trailer

en.name: Hidden Cats in Spooky Carnival

en.name: Milki Delivery
en.description: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside docks to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.

games.name: MATE, This Place is a MESS!
games.shortName: MATE, THIS PLACE IS A MESS!

en.name: MATE, This Place is a MESS!
en.description: MATE, This Place is a MESS! is a cozy organizing game where you sort 5,000 yerba mate packages in a messy museum. Fill the shelves, brew your mate, unlock abilities and kick packages into place. At the end of the hall, a huge curtain hides the truth about the museum. What could it be?

en.name: Malignus
