en.description: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

games.name: Wink Out
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 物理演算に基づく1対1シューティングでライバルを吹き飛ばそう！賢いカードシナジーを組み上げ、ラウンド間でビルドを調整し、相手をアリーナ外へ弾き飛ばして勝利をつかもう。

en.name: Wink Out
en.description: Wink Out your rivals in this physics-driven 1v1 shooter! Create clever synergies, adapt between rounds, and outplay opponents by sending them flying out of the arena.

games.name: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
games.description: みんなお待たせ！ 史上最も有名なゲームキャラが登場する未発表リメイクゲームが、エクセレントにリマスターされて帰ってきた！そう、『Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed』のおでましだ！

en.name: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
en.description: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.

games.name: HARMA 亡国のエデン
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 「HARMA 亡国のエデン」は、ストーリーモードを備えたダークファンタジーローグライクデッキ構築ゲームです。堕落した騎士団、燃え盛る王国、そして消えた国王……。この悲劇の裏に潜む真実を探さねばなりません。

en.name: HARMA
en.description: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

games.name: The Cozy Funemployment
genres: 人生シミュレーション
games.description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

en.name: The Cozy Funemployment
en.description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

games.name: Rock Band Simulator
genres: 没入シミュレーション
games.description: 一人称視点でロックバンドの生活を送るシミュレーター。リズムに合わせてライブをこなし、怪しい仕事を引き受け、賭けにケンカに明け暮れながら機材とガレージを充実させよう。バンドをまとめて、なんとか無事に一日を切り抜ける。何があっても、夜9時にはライブがある。

en.name: Rock Band Simulator
en.description: A first-person rock band life sim. Play rhythm-based gigs, take shady jobs, gamble, fight, and upgrade your gear and garage. Keep the band together and try to stay in one piece. Whatever happens, you’ve still got a show at nine.

games.name: Bunny Eureka
genres: 農場シミュレーション
人生シミュレーション
games.description: A little island full of bunnies. Have them farm and build homes, or do nothing and just watch them eat, sleep and play. Now and then, visitors bring new stories, and the bunnies write you letters.

en.name: Bunny Eureka
en.description: A little island full of bunnies. Have them farm and build homes, or do nothing and just watch them eat, sleep and play. Now and then, visitors bring new stories, and the bunnies write you letters.

games.name: サイコロ対決
games.description: ターン制ゲームとローグライクが融合！運と戦略が交わる冒険で、自分だけのスキルを作り、敵と戦い、強力な装置を見つけて世界を救おう！

en.name: Dice Showdown
en.description: Turn-based strategy meets Roguelike adventure! Enjoy a mix of luck and tactics. Build a unique skill set, battle various enemies, discover powerful devices, and save the world!

games.name: Highschool J
games.description: ユウキは、借金の重荷、わずかな友人、そして誰にも見せない詩と共に、ありふれた日々を送っていた。あの転校生が教室に現れるまでは。抗えない存在がある。ただ、ひれ伏すことしかできないのだ。

en.name: Highschool J
en.description: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, surrounded by a few friends, and consumed by poems shared with no one. Until the arrival of a transfer student. Because some presences cannot be resisted. Only surrender is possible.

games.name: Swarmbreaker
games.description: 『Swarmbreaker』は、異星の蟲が押し寄せる巨大な生きた波から自軍の拠点を守り抜く、インクリメンタル・タワーディフェンスです。防衛設備を築いて進路を塞ぎ、重火器を展開し、兵装を強化して、群れを打ち砕け！

en.name: Swarmbreaker
en.description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

games.name: We March as One
games.description: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

en.name: We March as One
en.description: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

games.name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
games.description: あなたは審問官。被告はルシファー。 堕天した天使たちを審問し、その運命を決めるダークロマンス・ビジュアルノベル。 救済か、破滅か――あるいは、もっと危険な結末か。 選択肢はたった一度きり。

trailers.name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer PV
Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer Teaser

en.name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
en.description: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction. One single, final choice.

games.name: Traveloot
games.description: Travelootは、成長する冒険者チームを率いて島々を巡る、ラン制のインクリメンタルゲームです。資源を集め、敵の大群と戦い、分岐するスキルツリーを解放し、新たな仲間を見つけてチームに加えましょう。ソロプレイはもちろん、ローカル協力プレイで友達と一緒に遊ぶこともできます。

en.name: Traveloot
en.description: Traveloot is a run-based incremental game where you guide a growing team of adventurers across islands. Gather resources, fight enemies, unlock branching skill tree, and find new party members to join your team. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

games.name: Widget Idle
games.description: あなたのデスクトップが、コントローラーになる。 クリックも、キー入力も、マウスの動きも。いつもの操作が、小さな世界を少しずつ育てていきます。Widget Idle はデスクトップの片隅で静かに、あなたがもっと大切なことに取り組んでいる間も、そっと寄り添います。いつもの日常に、ちょっとした幸せを :)

en.name: Widget Idle
en.description: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness :)

games.name: Undergod
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: Take over heaven in this airborne-combat roguelike where you fight hordes of angels while growing stronger every minute.

en.name: Undergod
en.description: Take over heaven in this airborne-combat roguelike where you fight hordes of angels while growing stronger every minute.

games.name: Rocket Scrapyard
games.description: 民間宇宙企業のスクラップ置き場を片付けて、ロケットのパーツを棚でセットにそろえ、毎晩自分だけのロケットを組み立てましょう。朝になったら打ち上げ！宇宙の境界に届くのか、軌道に乗るのか、それとも宇宙ステーションの建設に役立つのか？

en.name: Rocket Scrapyard
en.description: Tidy up a private space company's scrapyard, collect rocket parts into sets on your racks and build your own rocket every evening. In the morning it launches – will it reach the edge of space, orbit, or help build a space station?

games.name: 灯火の導く先へ
games.description: 『Where Lanterns Lead』は、不気味な中国の民間伝承を背景にしたシングルプレイの戦略育成RPG。技を学び、計略を組み合わせ、月ごとの修練やイベントで成長しましょう。限られたスロット、気力、行動回数、銅銭をやりくりし、戦闘と選択、計略の融合を通じて自分だけの戦い方を築いていきます。

trailers.name: ゲームプレイトレーラー

en.name: Where Lanterns Lead
en.description: Where Lanterns Lead is a single-player strategy RPG inspired by eerie Chinese folklore. Learn combat skills, combine tactics, manage your monthly growth, and shape your own fighting style through battles and choices.

games.name: 三国群雄：幸存者
games.description: A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival roguelite. Choose your hero, combine upgrades, and fight your way through enemy hordes.

trailers.name: 三国群雄：幸存者 玩法演示

en.name: Three Kingdoms: Survivors
en.description: A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival roguelite. Choose your hero, combine upgrades, and fight your way through enemy hordes.

games.name: Art Shop: Tidy Up!
games.description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 3022 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.

trailers.name: Gameplay Trailer - Art Shop: Tidy Up!
Launch Trailer - Art Shop: Tidy Up

en.name: Art Shop: Tidy Up!
en.description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 3022 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.

games.name: Dice Hoarder
games.description: 「Dice Hoarder」は、謎めいたダイスショップの品出しをする、ほのぼのとした整理整頓ゲームです。店内のダイスをすべて仕分けし、7個1組のTRPGダイスセットを完成させながら、新しい仕事の裏に隠された秘密を解き明かしていきましょう。

en.name: Dice Hoarder
en.description: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

games.name: How They Built the Pyramids
games.description: 1〜8人で遊べる、ハチャメチャなオンライン協力建築ゲーム。レンガを作り、巨大なピラミッドを建設しよう。生産ラインを自動化したり、仲間を雇ったり、あの手この手でレンガを頂上まで運ぼう！

en.name: How They Built the Pyramids
en.description: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

games.name: Dice Have No Eyes
games.description: ★ Surreal dice-rolling roguelike about luck and greed ★ Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all. Or get lucky, unlock King Fetus, meet God and you might just wake up.

en.name: Dice Have No Eyes
en.description: ★ Surreal dice-rolling roguelike about luck and greed ★ Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all. Or get lucky, unlock King Fetus, meet God and you might just wake up.

games.name: Sloppy Forgeries 名画のつもり！
games.shortName: SLOPPY FORGERIES 名画のつもり！
genres: デザイン＆イラストレーション
games.description: 『Sloppy Forgeries』は、名画とのそっくり度をリアルタイムでピクセルごとに採点する、ちょっと珍しいお絵描きゲーム。 お手本とはひと味違う作品を、「名画のつもり」で生み出しながら、腕を磨きましょう！

en.name: Sloppy Forgeries
en.description: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Practice your skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time.

games.name: Pill & Chill
games.description: 計数用スパチュラを使い、テーブルいっぱいに広がった色とりどりの錠剤を仕分けましょう。Pill & Chillは、制限時間もスコアもなく、心地よい小さな音を楽しめる、物理演算ベースのリラックス整理ゲームです。

en.name: Pill & Chill
en.description: Sort a tabletop full of colorful pills with a counting spatula. Pill & Chill is a relaxing, physics-based organizing game with no pressure, and lots of satisfying little sounds.

games.name: Tidy Up the Wonderlands of Mirad
games.shortName: TIDY UP THE WONDERLANDS OF MIRAD
games.description: この心地よいお片付けで、2500+ 個の小さな土地を仕分けましょう。ピースはそれぞれ実際に歩ける土地として隆起し、配置するたびにアップグレードを獲得できます。

en.name: Tidy Up the Wonderlands of Mirad
en.description: Sort thousands of tiny lands in this cozy tidy-up. Each piece rises as real land you can walk on, and every one earns you upgrades. Play Solo or Co-op.

games.name: 正午の影
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
games.description: 正午の影は、いちばん短い。この光の下では何も隠せないと、思ってしまうほどに。灯りの下でゆっくり本を読むのが好きな人へ贈る、本格ミステリーのインタラクティブ・サウンドノベル。事件を解くのに必要なものは、すべてあなたが読んだページに書いてある。二〇一五年冬の夜、雨坂市。屋敷の長男が階段の下で死に、翌朝、家政婦が自首した。階段にこぼれたスープは、まだ温かかった。

en.name: Shadow at Noon
en.description: Noon casts the shortest shadows. A honkaku mystery told as an interactive sound novel: every clue is in black and white, on pages you've read. Amesaka, winter 2015. A son lies dead at the foot of the stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. The soup spilled on the steps is still warm.

games.name: Desktop Maidens
games.description: 最高に可愛い美少女たちと進む放置系冒険ゲーム！デスクトップの片隅で、いつでも気ままに冒険が楽しめちゃ！仲間を集めて、未知の世界の奥深くへ冒険に出発！数百種類を超えるモンスターが待ち受ける冒険の世界で、豊富な装備を集め、強くなろう！

en.name: Desktop Maidens
en.description: Let maiden adventurers keep you company on your desktop as they journey into the unknown. Whether you’re working, studying, or taking a break, check in anytime to see what they’ve brought back.

games.name: Gently Packed
genres: 職業シミュレーション
games.description: 『Gently Packed』でレジ係になってみよう。商品をスキャンし、袋詰めし、丁寧にお客様を対応する、リラックスできる店舗経営ゲームです。お店をアップグレードし、プロモーションを実施し、企業の目標を達成して、フランチャイズのローンを返済しましょう。

en.name: Gently Packed
en.description: Step into the shoes of a cashier in Gently Packed, a relaxing store management game where you scan, pack, and serve customers with care. Upgrade your shop, run promotions, meet corporate goals, and pay off your franchise loan.

games.name: Way Too Many Fish!
games.description: Way Too Many Fish! は自分の漁船で遊ぶ、のんびりとした仕分けゲーム。網を引き上げ、甲板に漁獲をぶちまけ、82種すべての魚を正しい木箱へ投げ入れましょう。

en.name: Way Too Many Fish!
en.description: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

games.name: Crackheads
games.description: 人でも、最大50人のプレイヤーとでも、クラックに満ちたカオスな世界を冒険しよう。 仲間を裏切るか、手を組んで金を稼ぎ、自分だけの帝国を築くかはあなた次第。盗み、暴れ、のし上がれ。そしてハイなまま、すべてを楽しもう。

en.name: Crackheads
en.description: Explore the marvelous world of Crackheads alone or with up to 50 players. Team up, turn on your friends, make money, build your empire, scavenge trash for questionable meals, and stay high through all of it.

games.name: Night Crew
games.description: あなたと最大5人の仲間で掃除して、修理して、生き延びる協力型ホラーゲーム。舞台はローファイなモール、トラブルはハイボリューム。Night Crewへようこそ。この給料じゃ、ぜんっぜん割に合わない！

en.name: Night Crew
en.description: A lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Foul creatures roam the halls - and management still expects YOU to mop the floor. Even though the floor ate Gary. Welcome to the Night Crew. You are 𝙙𝙚𝙛𝙞𝙣𝙞𝙩𝙚𝙡𝙮 not paid enough for this.

games.name: Rasen
games.description: 精密に攻撃し、ブロックを同期させ、リズムに合わせて戦いましょう。雰囲気のあるPvPまたはPvEアリーナに参加し、激しいデュエルや速い戦闘で多様な致命的なキャラクターと対戦しましょう。GGPOスタイルのロールバックネットコードを搭載し、応答性の高いオンライン対戦を実現。

en.name: Rasen
en.description: Strike with precision, time your deflects and fight flawlessly to your own rhythm. Step into atmospheric PvP or PvE arena duels and fast-paced clashes with a variety of lethal characters. Featuring GGPO-style rollback netcode for responsive online matches.

games.name: Um Al-Saaf
genres: パズルプラットフォーム
games.description: On Filka Island: Explore the abandoned clinic, collect items, solve puzzles, and unlock doors while avoiding Aunt Safa. Can you find the treasure and escape before she catches you?

en.name: Um Al-Saaf
en.description: On Filka Island: Explore the abandoned clinic, collect items, solve puzzles, and unlock doors while avoiding Aunt Safa. Can you find the treasure and escape before she catches you?

games.name: ScopeCreep
games.description: 囁く炎は魂を求める。捧げ物をするたびに、あなたの決意は強まる。霊と戦い、その精髄を集め、決して満たされないかもしれない飢えを養え、この短くアクティブなインクリメンタルで。

en.name: ScopeCreep
en.description: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

games.name: Setter: Volleyball Manager 27
games.description: Setter is a volleyball management game where every decision shapes your club. Build and develop your squad in a competitive transfer market where rivals can bid for your players, prepare your lineup and tactics, and watch every rally unfold as you compete for domestic titles and continental success.

trailers.name: Setter: Volleyball Manager 27 | Official Announcement Trailer

en.name: Setter: Volleyball Manager 27
en.description: Setter is a volleyball management game where every decision shapes your club. Build and develop your squad in a competitive transfer market where rivals can bid for your players, prepare your lineup and tactics, and watch every rally unfold as you compete for domestic titles and continental success.

games.name: モンスター娘サバイバル&クラフト2040
games.shortName: モンスター娘サバイバル&クラフト2040
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
games.description: 2040年 異世界に浸食された都市であなたは目を覚ます。地形はどこまでも掘れる。ブロックを積めば家も城も要塞も作れる。荒野で出会うモンスター娘は捕獲すれば仲間になる。共に戦い 共に暮らし あなたの王国を支えてくれる。そして7日ごとの夜には群れが押し寄せる。壁を築き罠を仕掛けて迎え撃て。守り切った朝 あなたはこの世界がもっと好きになっている。

trailers.name: Monster Girls Survival and Craft 2040 PV

en.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
en.description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

games.name: No One to See – Pinebark Camp
games.shortName: NO ONE TO SEE – PINEBARK CAMP
games.description: つらい時期を過ごしていたイーサンは、ひとりでパインバークの森へキャンプに行くことにした。数日だけでもすべてから離れ、静けさの中で過ごしたかった。だが彼は知らなかった。パインバークでは、その静けさもまた耳を澄ませていることを。

en.name: No One to See – Pinebark Camp
en.description: Going through a hard time, Ethan decided to go camping alone in the Pinebark woods. He wanted to get away from everything for a few days and find a little silence. He just didn't expect that, in Pinebark, the silence would be listening too.

games.name: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure
games.description: Embark on a brand-new RuneScape idle adventure with Melvor Idle 2. Master iconic RuneScape Skills, face powerful Combat challenges, or uncover the history of the world via Quests, all while enjoying zen-like progression.

en.name: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure
en.description: Embark on a brand-new RuneScape idle adventure with Melvor Idle 2. Master iconic RuneScape Skills, face powerful Combat challenges, or uncover the history of the world via Quests, all while enjoying zen-like progression.

games.name: 直感を信じろ
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: マルチボール・ルーレットのローグライト。複数のボールを一斉に投げ入れ、ホイールそのものを書き換えましょう。色を足し、数字を変え、配当を組み替え、倍率を重ねがけ。武器は100種以上のメメントと、クセ者ぞろいの特殊ボール50種。あなたは狂気のテレビ番組に生出演中。人形の司会者がニタリと笑っています。彼の課すノルマを果たせなければ、番組があなたの人生を打ち切ります。

en.name: Trust Your Gut
en.description: A multi-ball roulette roguelite. Spin multiple balls at once and rewrite the wheel: add colors, change the numbers, rebalance payouts and stack multipliers with 100+ mementos and 50 trick balls. You’re live on a twisted TV show, and the puppet Host is grinning. Hit his targets, or the show ends you.

games.name: Novus Orbis
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 時空を巡るループを舞台にしたコンボ型デッキ構築ローグライク。カードを集め、恵みを受け、ペットを仲間に加え、さらなる強さを手に入れよう。カードを正しい順番で組み合わせて最大限の力を引き出し、敵が行動する前に先手を打て。相乗効果を生み出すデッキを構築し、数々の秘密を発見し、ケタ違いの数字を叩き出そう！

en.name: Novus Orbis
en.description: A combo-based deckbuilding roguelike through a space-time loop: collect cards, receive blessings, add pets to your party, and grow stronger. Chain together cards in the right order for max power, and act before the enemy does. Build synergistic decks, find many secrets, and make BIG numbers!

games.name: Defender Bros
games.description: 昼間は防御を整え、夜明けまで生き延びろ。《防衛兄弟》は、タワーディフェンス型Roguelikeゲームで、あなたは基地を守る兵士を演じる。レベルが上がるにつれて、さまざまな能力から選択することができ、戦闘ラウンドの終了後には、自分を強化するためのボーナスを購入することもできる。

en.name: Defender Bros
en.description: Prepare your defenses during the day and survive until dawn. Defender Bros is a Top-Down Tower Defense Roguelike where you play as a Soldier defending your Base. Pick between multiple abilities as you level up to increase your power, then after each run buy perks and get stronger

games.name: Monkeys!¡
games.description: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!

en.name: Monkeys!¡
en.description: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!

games.name: マブラヴ ガールズガーデン Mellow Days
games.shortName: マブラヴ ガールズガーデン MELLOW DAYS
games.description: 『マブラヴ ガールズガーデン Mellow Days』は、桃園めると同じ時間を過ごしながら、毎日の作業を進める作業支援ADVです。 ポモドーロタイマーやToDo、カレンダー、音楽、環境音を自分好みに整え、一緒に頑張った時間を重ねることで、めるとの物語が少しずつ動き始めます。

trailers.name: MUV-LUV GIRLS GARDEN Mellow Days - Official Trailer(JP)

en.name: MUV-LUV GIRLS GARDEN Mellow Days
en.description: Muv-Luv Girls Garden Mellow Days is a productivity companion adventure game where you work alongside Meru Momozono. Customize your Pomodoro timer, to-do list, calendar, music, and ambient sounds. As you spend more time together, your story with Meru gradually unfolds.

games.name: Underbloom
games.description: 育ち方を忘れた森の下で、小さなキノコが目を覚ます。光る菌糸網を9つの隠された世界へ広げ、ちょっと不思議なご近所さんと出会い、ココロの種を起こそう。ちゃんとエンディングのある、ほっこりインクリメンタルゲーム。

en.name: Underbloom
en.description: Under a forest that forgot how to grow, one small mushroom wakes up. Spread a glowing web through nine hidden worlds, meet their small, strange neighbours, and wake the Heartseed. A cozy incremental game with a real ending.

games.name: Orcthal
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 侵略者はお前だ。3D survivors-likeでオーク戦士となり、軍勢をなぎ倒せ。アビリティは自動で発動。レベルを上げ、強力なパークを選び、倒れた敵を漁り、集落を略奪し、何度でも戻ってさらに強くなれ！

en.name: Orcthal
en.description: You are the raid. Play as an orc warrior carving through armies! Auto-cast devastating abilities, level up with powerful perks, loot the fallen, pillage their settlements and come back again, and again, stronger!

games.name: Lost Luggage
games.description: 世界中のフライトから届いた持ち主不明のスーツケースを買い取り、こじ開けて中身をチェック。靴下、カメラ、金の延べ棒、それともゴムのアヒル？見つけた品はすべて手荷物ベルトで売りさばき、ほこりまみれのガレージを自動化された手荷物ビジネスへと育て上げよう。

en.name: Lost Luggage
en.description: Buy lost suitcases from flights around the world, crack them open and see what is inside: socks, cameras, gold bricks or a rubber duck. Sell every find on the baggage belt and grow your dusty garage into an automated luggage business.

games.name: Green Again
games.description: 癒しのコロニーシミュレーションゲームで、荒廃した惑星に再び緑を取り戻そう！暴走したロボットに占領されてしまった惑星。小さな植物の民たちが住みかを取り戻せるよう手助けし、集落を築き、飾り、守り抜こう。住民のために作物を育て、未知の世界を探索し、豊かな自然と新しい生命の秩序を守り抜こう！

en.name: Green Again
en.description: Make the planet Green Again in this relaxing colony sim game! Help a nation of little plant people reclaim their planet taken over by defective robots, as you build, decorate, and defend your settlement. Grow crops for your citizens, explore the unknown, and protect the new natural order!

games.name: Village Invaders
games.description: 『Village Invaders』は、村を襲撃するテンポの速いローグライト・カードバトル。部隊を配置し、無茶な呪文を放ち、最高のデッキを組み上げて、行く手の王国をすべて叩き潰せ。村は挑むたびに自動生成され、防衛施設も罠も戦利品の位置も毎回変わる。

en.name: Village Invaders
en.description: A fast-paced roguelite card battler where you raid villages. Deploy your army, cast wild spells and build the perfect deck to crush every kingdom in your path.

games.name: アケノヨスガ - Twilight Loop -
games.shortName: アケノヨスガ - TWILIGHT LOOP -
games.description: 17時になると、彼女は必ず死ぬ。 何度時間を巻き戻しても繰り返される少女の死。彼女を救うため、同じ一日を繰り返し、死の運命に抗うループ型・心理ホラーADV。

en.name: Ake no Yosuga - Twilight Loop
en.description: At 5:00 PM, she always dies. No matter how many times time rewinds, her death repeats. Relive the same day, uncover the truth, and defy her fate in this time-loop psychological horror adventure.

games.name: KALA
games.description: 釣る、食べる、吐く、飾る、眠る。そして繰り返す。『KALA』は、過去の罪に苛まれ、孤島に自ら自身を追放した男を描く、短編シュールホラーゲームです。

en.name: KALA
en.description: Fish. Eat. Vomit. Adorn. Sleep. Repeat. KALA is a short, surreal horror game about a man who exiled himself to a remote island, haunted by the sins of his past.

games.name: The Christmas Bakeshop
genres: 職業シミュレーション
games.description: Supply festive breads, pastries, and sweet treats while serving cheerful customers and keeping your shop warm and welcoming. Expand your bakery, discover new recipes, and make your cozy little corner the heart of the town this holiday season.

en.name: The Christmas Bakeshop
en.description: Supply festive breads, pastries, and sweet treats while serving cheerful customers and keeping your shop warm and welcoming. Expand your bakery, discover new recipes, and make your cozy little corner the heart of the town this holiday season.

games.name: Trees Hate You
games.description: 恐ろしい木たちががうようよする最凶最悪の森の中をさまよえ。どの木もお前を騙す、いじめる、傷つける。なので絶対気を許すな。しかし斧さえ見つかれば…

en.name: Trees Hate You
en.description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Gold Miner: Party Rush
games.description: ゴールドマイナー：パーティーラッシュは、クラシックなゴールドマイナーのクレーンを対面競争の舞台に持ち込んだ2〜6人用マルチプレイヤーパーティーゲームです。クイックマッチとランクマッチで競い、エンドレスは協力で深く掘り、1台のPCで画面を分け合って、もちろん1人でも遊べます。

en.name: Gold Miner: Party Rush
en.description: Gold Miner: Party Rush is a multiplayer party game for 2 to 6 players where the classic Gold Miner crane goes head-to-head. Outlast rivals in Quick Match and Ranked, dig deeper in co-op Endless, share one screen on the couch, or play solo.

games.name: キングマイン：ジオフロント
games.shortName: キングマイン：ジオフロント
games.description: ドワーフ鉱夫たちが、地下王国を再建する！爽快感なインクリメンタル採掘＆経営ゲームで、ドワーフを率いる王となれ！採掘ルートを計画し、松明が燃え尽きる前に鉱脈を掘り尽くせ。集めた金鉱石で地下王都を築き、領地を広げ、仲間を集め、ドワーフ技術を強化して巨大鉱山をぶっ壊せ！

trailers.name: King in the Mountain - Launch Trailer

en.name: King in the Mountain
en.description: A resource management incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Manage production, upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

games.name: Choice of Life: Modern Ages
games.description: 荒れた家庭に生まれても、首都でどう生きるかは自分で決められる。真面目に勉強するか犯罪の道に進むか、普通に就職するか起業するか、政界に入るか。どの選択も未来を変えていく。全てか無かの勝負だ。

en.name: Choice of Life: Modern Ages
en.description: Choose how to live in Capital City after a rough start at home. Study hard or choose the criminal path, take a regular job or become an entrepreneur, or go into politics. Every choice shapes your future, all or nothing.

games.name: STEEL GULLET
games.description: 物理法則がすべてを決める工場自動化ゲーム。リアルな熱力学で、混沌としたスクラップを溶かし、分離し、精錬します。素材は個数ではなく質量で扱い、物性に応じて製品を作り、限られたスペースで複雑な生産ラインを最適化しましょう。

en.name: STEEL GULLET
en.description: A physics-driven factory automation game. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on physical properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

games.name: Clicky Islands / クリッキーアイランド
games.shortName: CLICKY ISLANDS / クリッキーアイランド
games.description: 『Clicky Islands / クリッキーアイランド』は、クリッカー要素・都市建設・そしてリソース管理を融合させたユニークなインクリメンタルゲームです。王に任命された総督として未開拓の島に赴き、王国の未来のために島を発展させましょう。

en.name: Clicky Islands
en.description: Clicky Islands is an incremental game with a full city builder inside. Settle procedurally generated islands, build production chains, put your workers to work and ship goods for gold as your economy grows. Unlock permanent upgrades and find the perfect island for His Majesty’s future kingdom

games.name: Witch the Showdown
games.description: パリィ×デッキ構築×ボスラッシュの死にゲーアクション！ 『Witch the Showdown』はボスのみと戦っていく、パリィでマナを貯めて、リアルタイムでカードを使って攻撃するバトルシステムが特徴の、高難易度パリィアクションゲームです！

en.name: Witch the Showdown
en.description: Witch the Showdown is a high-difficulty parry-action game where every battle is a boss fight. Build mana through precise parries, then unleash attacks in real time using your cards—this unique combat system defines the experience.

games.name: Bannerlings
games.description: 戦略ローグライト・オートバトラーで、無敵の軍勢を築き上げよう。Bannerlingsを融合させ、強力なエンブレムのシナジーを生み出し、予測不能な戦いを乗り越えながら、最終ボスを目指せ。

en.name: Bannerlings
en.description: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.

games.name: Frog Collector
genres: 趣味シミュレーション
games.description: コレクション用のカエルであふれかえったお店を片づけよう。カラフルなフィギュアを拾って仕分け、テーマ別の棚を埋め、便利なアップグレードを解放し、隠されたタマゴを探そう。カエルをひとつずつ集めて、自分だけのコレクションを作り上げよう。

en.name: Frog Collector
en.description: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.

games.name: 憧れの家
games.description: 『 憧れの家』で、理想の家を作りましょう！豊富なこだわりパーツから好きなものを選び、お部屋や庭をイチからコーディネート。ゆったりとしたLo-fi BGMに耳を傾けながら、自分だけの癒やしの空間と心安らぐ時間をお楽しみください。

en.name: Tiny Dwellings
en.description: From the creators of Moonfrost, Tiny Dwellings is a whimsical hand-drawn spin-off builder with kindred pixelly vibes! Delight in designing your dream petite homesteads and charming dioramas. Unwind in a stress-free haven and dig the heartwarming lo-fi ambiences as you express your creative muse.

games.name: Warpack
genres: 非同期マルチプレイヤー
games.description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

en.name: Warpack
en.description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

games.name: OKUREK
games.description: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. COZY-PICKLE-HORROR experience set in the acidic mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

en.name: OKUREK
en.description: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. COZY-PICKLE-HORROR experience set in the acidic mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

games.name: TOMIDER
games.description: 少年トミが、十年前に学校を襲った悲劇の真相に迫る心理ホラー。90年代の町オフォードを探索し、手がかりを集め、闇が本当に隠しているものを暴き出せ。

en.name: TOMIDER
en.description: A psychological horror about Tomi, a teenager unraveling the truth behind a tragedy that struck his school ten years ago. Explore the 1990s town of Oford, gather clues, and discover what the darkness is really hiding.

games.name: BOOM! Buster
games.description: Inspired by early 2010s rage games, BOOM! Buster bursts through the arcade genre with a fresh, new experience in this unrelenting hot-potato platformer.

en.name: BOOM! Buster
en.description: Inspired by early 2010s rage games, BOOM! Buster bursts through the arcade genre with a fresh, new experience in this unrelenting hot-potato platformer.

games.name: エンジェル投資家シミュレーター
games.shortName: エンジェル投資家シミュレーター
games.description: 資本を操り、トレンドを掴み、小さな元手から巨万の富を築け！資産数百億のエンジェル投資家となり、有望なスタートアップの発掘や出資競争、チーム編成に挑め。刻々と変化する市場を読み切る本格派の金融シミュレーション。最初の投資から、一大ビジネス帝国を創り上げろ！

en.name: Angel Investor Simulator™
en.description: Invest into promising startups with sometimes wacky ideas. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.

games.name: Flick
games.description: 部屋のスイッチを入れると、現実はオフになる。グロテスクな世界へと飛び込み、家族の歪んだ過去を明らかにせよ。このサイコロジカルホラーでは、明かりがなくては進めない。しかし、その光は戦慄の悪夢を呼び寄せる――あなたはこの恐怖から逃げ切れるか？

en.name: Flick
en.description: Flick light switches on and off throughout a long-abandoned house to shift the environment from a safe reality to a horror-filled echo where wicked puzzles manifest. A short psychological horror game where you must balance the light needed to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: KORRIDOR
games.description: 容赦なきゲートシューターで悪魔の群れを退けろ！重厚なヘヴィメタルサウンドに身を包み、モンスターを倒し、アップグレードを手に入れて強力なビルドを作り上げ、ボスを粉砕せよ。カタコンベの奥深くで、数多の敵と秘密があなたを待っている…

en.name: KORRIDOR
en.description: Fight off hordes of demons in this unforgiving gates shooter! Slay monsters, pick up upgrades, and create overpowered builds to annihilate bosses while listening to heavy metal tracks. Many foes and secrets await you in the catacombs...

games.name: アストラルハンター：帰還
games.shortName: アストラルハンター：帰還
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
games.description: これはトップダウン視点のアクションローグライトゲームです。武器を選択し、群がる異星生物たちと戦いましょう。様々なアップグレードモジュールやアイテムを組み合わせて、独自の戦闘スタイルを構築できます。異星生物を捕獲してその能力を使うことも、基地に連れ帰り素材を生産させることも可能。使えるキャラを増やして、この惑星を征服しよう！

en.name: Astral Hunter: Homebound
en.description: A top-down action roguelite where you capture pets and battle alien hordes. Choose your weapons and combine upgrades and items to create your own combat style. Capture alien creatures to use their abilities or bring them to your base for materials. Recruit new characters and conquer the planet!

games.name: Water TD
games.description: Water TDは、敵が洪水のタワーディフェンスゲーム。何十万もの水滴が拠点へ押し寄せ、砲台の前に溜まり、あらゆる隙間からあふれ出す。撃って、燃やして、電撃を浴びせて、押し返そう。ステージの合間には、大きなスキルツリーで守りをアップグレードしよう。

en.name: Water TD
en.description: Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a real flood. Hundreds of thousands of drops pour downhill toward your base, piling up, finding gaps and carving the terrain as they go. Shoot it, burn it, zap it, or blow it back. Just don't expect the ground to hold.

games.name: Of Dice and Minions
games.description: 5個のサイコロを振り、ポーカーの役でミニオンの軍団を召喚。あとは自動で戦う様子を見守ろう。キープ、振り直し、仲間の雇用、相手に合わせた編成で100階を攻略する、ローグライト・オートバトラー。

en.name: Of Dice and Minions
en.description: Roll five dice and chase poker hands to summon a minion army, then watch it fight. Hold, reroll, recruit, and counter your way down 100 floors in this roguelite auto battler.

games.name: My Dirty Little Lake
games.description: ほっこり、のんびり、サクッと遊べる短編。あみを投げて、よごれた湖をきれいにし、自然を取りもどしましょう。犬たちもお手伝い。ゴミをリサイクルしてお金をかせぎ、道具を強化しましょう。湖にはお宝がたくさんかくれています。見つけたら、スッキリ気持ちいいミニゲームで洗って、家をかざりましょう。生き物たちも、あなたのがんばりに感謝しています。

en.name: My Dirty Little Lake
en.description: Cozy, short and relaxing: cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back. With dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear. Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house. Wildlife appreciates your work.

games.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
games.description: 傭兵チームに参加せよ：ハイリスク・ローリターンのポジション募集中！革新的なターン制タワーディフェンスゲームとリバース弾幕を融合したゲームで貨物列車を防御せよ。unitsを展開、mergeして強力な新タイプやバリエーションを編成し、際限なく湧いてくる敵を撃退して貨物を目的地へ届けよう。

trailers.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business - Launch Trailer

en.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
en.description: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.

games.name: IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU
games.shortName: IT THINKS! - BUILD YOUR OWN GPU
games.description: AIを動かすチップを設計しよう。たった1個の論理ゲートからコンピューターを作り、回路を配線し、設計を再利用可能なチップに変え、小さなkernelを書き、動作するGPUへとアーキテクチャを拡張していく。

en.name: IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU
en.description: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

games.name: 771: Smile and work
games.description: 『771: Smile and work』は、一人称視点の心理ホラーゲームです。オフィス。夜勤。上司からの指示。一体何が起こるというのでしょうか？

en.name: 771: Smile and work
en.description: "771: Smile and work" is a first-person psychological horror game. An office. A night shift. Orders from your boss. What could go wrong?

games.name: Littlelands
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
games.description: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

en.name: Littlelands
en.description: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

games.name: Theocracy
games.description: The prophecy is clear: you have one hundred years to unite the Aztec tribes and prepare for the Spanish invasion. Theocracy is a unique blend of RTS, grand strategy and city building. Develop towns, raise armies, cast spells and conquer provinces - build an empire that can change history.

en.name: Theocracy
en.description: The prophecy is clear: you have one hundred years to unite the Aztec tribes and prepare for the Spanish invasion. Theocracy is a unique blend of RTS, grand strategy and city building. Develop towns, raise armies, cast spells and conquer provinces - build an empire that can change history.

games.name: HeroInc
genres: 選択方式アドベンチャー
games.description: ノーバディから、街が求めるヒーローを育てよう。鍛え、働き、戦う相手を選べ。力が足りない日は恐怖が広がっていく戦術オートバトラー。6つのクラス、傭兵エージェンシー、ライバルのボス、30のクエスト。1週間を計画したら、殴るのはヒーローに任せよう。

en.name: HeroInc
en.description: Start as a Nobody and build the hero the city needs. Train, work and pick your fights in this tactical auto-battler where Fear spreads every day you fall short. Six classes, a merc agency, rival bosses and 30 quests: plan your week, then watch your hero do the punching.

games.name: クロスランド せいれいたちとつむぐせかい
games.shortName: クロスランド せいれいたちとつむぐせかい
games.description: 『コージーグローブ』の制作陣が贈る最新作！パステルカラーの雲の間をグライダーで飛び、迷子になった精霊を助けながら、高くそびえる山頂に自分だけの理想の家をデザインできるマルチプレイヤーライフシム。あたたかいキャンプファイヤーを囲んで見知らぬ誰かと友達になったり、並んでのんびり空を飛び、雲海を泳ぐ魚を釣って思い出を分かち合ったり。不思議で愛おしい「新たな我が家」へようこそ。🏠🏔️

en.name: Spirit Crossing
en.description: From the makers of Cozy Grove: Glide through pastel clouds, help lost spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend. Welcome to your strange new home. 🏠🏔️

games.name: DERELIKT
games.description: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.

en.name: DERELIKT
en.description: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.

games.name: Gangsters Way
genres: ベルトスクロールアクション
games.description: 拳ひとつでマフィアにのし上がれ。三人称視点のシングルプレイ格闘アクション。攻撃をかわし、コンボや必殺技を繰り出して、マフィア屈指の腕利きたちに一対一の決闘や多対一の乱闘で挑め。

en.name: Gangsters Way
en.description: Fight your way into the mafia in a single-player third-person brawler. Dodge strikes, chain combos, and unleash special moves as you take on the mob’s best fighters in one-on-one duels and brawls against multiple opponents.

games.name: Tie Down
genres: 乗り物シミュレーション
games.description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

en.name: Tie Down
en.description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

games.name: ヒア・カムズ・ザ・ホード
games.shortName: ヒア・カムズ・ザ・ホード
games.description: インクリメンタルオートバトラー『Here Comes the Horde』で、大軍勢を率いて不死の敵の軍団から城を守ろう。襲撃を切り抜け、新しいユニットをアンロックし、強力なアビリティを手に入れ、画面を何千もの部隊でいっぱいにするのだ。

en.name: Here Comes the Horde
en.description: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.

games.name: Below the Stone
games.description: Below the Stone is an extraction roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

en.name: Below the Stone
en.description: Below the Stone is an extraction roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

games.name: Trakonius
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 残酷なアリーナの砂の中で、生き残るために戦うことを強いられた剣闘士。トラコニウスは、このアクション・ローグライクゲームで戦神マルスに挑む！4つの死のアリーナで、剣闘士や神話の生物、過酷な試練に立ち向かえ。真実は戦いの中でのみ明かされる！ 4つの致命的なアリーナで、グラディエーター、神話の生物、そして数々の試練に立ち向かえ。自由のために戦い、民のために勝利せよ！

en.name: Trakonius
en.description: In the merciless sands of the arena, a gladiator is forced to fight for survival. Trakonius defies Mars, the God of War, in this Action Roguelike experience! Face gladiators, mythological creatures, and deadly challenges across four brutal arenas. The truth can only be revealed through combat!

games.name: Marque & Reprisal
games.description: 探索、交易、漁、捕鯨、植民、戦闘、略奪、そして生存。時は1522年。船長となり、世界全土を舞台にしたローグライク要素のある歴史航海サンドボックスで、未知の海へ漕ぎ出そう。

en.name: Marque & Reprisal
en.description: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

games.name: Demockracy
genres: 政治シミュレーション
games.description: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?

en.name: Demockracy
en.description: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?

games.name: ASSAULT SHELL 2
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
games.description: A high-risk, high reward shoot em up as you power yourself and your enemies up to bring utter chaos to the battlefield!

en.name: ASSAULT SHELL 2
en.description: A high-risk, high reward shoot em up as you power yourself and your enemies up to bring utter chaos to the battlefield!

games.name: Digbound
games.description: Digboundは、短時間で気軽に楽しめる一人称視点の採掘ゲームです。地面を掘り進めて貴重な鉱石を見つけ、売却して装備を強化し、さらに深い場所を目指しましょう。

en.name: Digbound
en.description: Digbound is a short and relaxing first-person mining game. Dig through the earth, uncover valuable ores, sell what you find, and upgrade your equipment to reach new depths.

games.name: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus
games.description: ピニャータを砕き、キャンディを集め、ショーを取り仕切れ！観客があなたの代わりに投げる、スピード感あふれるアクティブ・インクリメンタル。アリーナを強化し、カジノで勝負し、止まることを知らない数字を育て上げろ！

en.name: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus
en.description: Smash piñatas, collect candy, run the show! A fast active incremental game where the crowd throws for you. Upgrade your arena, gamble at the casino, and grow a number that refuses to stop!

games.name: 器に喰わせろ
games.description: 培養槽でクローンを育て、「存在」に喰わせ、解体し、燃やして肉・血・イコルに変え、船のステーションを強化し、「番人」を生み出し、航海の果てで「存在」と戦う、短く濃密なアクティブ系インクリメンタルゲーム。

en.name: Feed The Vessel
en.description: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the Entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, create Wardens, and fight the Entity at the end of the voyage.

games.name: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria
games.description: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria is a turn-based fantasy strategy game of conquest and heroes. Capture cities, recruit armies from ten distinct factions, level up your units, and clash in fast one-on-one duels where the marching order you choose decides the battle.

en.name: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria
en.description: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria is a turn-based fantasy strategy game of conquest and heroes. Capture cities, recruit armies from ten distinct factions, level up your units, and clash in fast one-on-one duels where the marching order you choose decides the battle.

games.name: デッドバイデイライト
games.shortName: デッドバイデイライト
games.description: 恐怖に満ちた10年。ジャンプスケアに間一髪の回避、残酷な処刑に手に汗握る脱出劇…それは死と隣り合わせの10年。 不気味な悪が支配する領域に、永遠に閉じ込められた生存者たち…その死にさえ救済のない世界で、粘り強い生存者4人と血に飢えた殺人鬼1人が知恵と度胸の試される残酷なゲームに挑む。最高の非対称マルチプレイホラーゲームで生存者または殺人鬼となり、スリルと恐怖に満ちた世界を堪能しよう。

en.name: Dead by Daylight
en.description: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.

games.name: Shift At Midnight
games.description: 最大3人でオンライン協力プレイを楽しめる、探偵ホラーゲーム。ランダムに生成されたシフトで力を合わせて客を調査し、誰が人間になりすましているかを突き止めよう。一つでもミスをすれば、建物に立てこもって罠を仕掛け、身を隠さなければならない。

en.name: Shift At Midnight
en.description: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.

games.name: Content Warning
games.description: SpöökTubeでバズるために、怖いことをしているお友達の姿を撮ろう！(一人で行かないことを強くオススメする）

en.name: Content Warning
en.description: Film your friends doing scary things to become SpöökTube famous! (strongly advised to not go alone)

games.name: Escape from Playtime
games.description: 廃墟と化したおもちゃ工場に閉じ込められたあなたと仲間たちが繰り広げる、1～4人向けオンライン協力型ホラーゲーム。目的を明かさぬ謎の声に従って変化し続ける道を探索し、道具を探しながら闇に潜むクリーチャーと生き残りをかけて戦おう。

trailers.name: Release Date Trailer - Escape from Playtime
Everything You Need To Know - Escape From Playtime

en.name: Escape from Playtime
en.description: An online 2-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

games.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
games.description: 「状況を正す」べく、海に浮かぶ孤島セントアメリアへと呼び戻されたサイモン・オーデル。だが、そんな彼を緊張感の漂うステルス、一触即発の戦闘、そして知を試される困難なパズルが待ち受ける。全てを越えた先に待つ、霧に沈んだ町の深淵に隠された真相とは。

en.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
en.description: Returning to an island town to ‘put things right’, Simon Ordell descends into a world of tense evasion, explosive confrontations, and mind-bending puzzles that slowly surface the truth of St. Amelia.

games.name: YAPYAP
games.description: YapYapとは、魔導師となり、ライバルの塔を荒らすために最大5人の友だちを手下として召喚する魔法協力型ホラーゲームだ。様々な呪文を唱え、塔を守る魔獣やモンスターを避けつつ破壊目標を達成せよ。

en.name: YAPYAP
en.description: A magic-themed co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends are minions summoned by a wizard to break into their rival's towers to cause mayhem. Try to fufill your vandalism target with an assortment of spells while avoiding magical beasts and monsters that protect the tower.

games.name: REANIMAL
games.description: Little Nightmares™ I & IIのクリエイターからお届けするダークで恐ろしい冒険。このホラー・アドベンチャーゲームは、ある兄弟が行方不明の友達を助け、故郷の島から逃げ出す物語を描いています。

en.name: REANIMAL
en.description: The creators of Little Nightmares™ I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

games.name: 零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE
games.description: 今度こそ離さない―― 妖しく羽化する、美しき恐怖。

trailers.name: 『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』ローンチトレーラー
『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』ゲーム紹介トレーラー
『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』発売日告知トレーラー

en.name: FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE
en.description: Together, always.

games.name: GONE Fishing
games.description: GONE Fishing は、1〜8人で遊べるサバイバルホラーです。仲間と力を合わせ、釣りで生き延びましょう。生き残る唯一の方法は、湖の底なしの飢えを満たし続けること。さもなければ、喰われるのはあなたです。 あなたはその飢えを満たせるか……それとも、次の生贄になるか？

en.name: GONE Fishing
en.description: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

games.name: Active Matter
games.description: 崩壊した多元宇宙を舞台にした、この新しいリアルミリタリーシューターで、戦利品を求めて危険なレイドに参加したり、激しいPvPバトルに参加したりしよう。時間と空間を曲げる物質「アクティブマター」の支配権をめぐり、量子不安定ゾーンで戦え。

en.name: Active Matter
en.description: Join dangerous raids for loot or intense PvP/PvE battles in this new realistic military shooter set in a fractured multiverse. Fight in quantum-unstable zones for control of active matter - the substance that bends time and space.

games.name: Visage
games.description: Visage は一人称視点の心理ホラーゲームです。 薄気味悪い慰めと恐ろしいほど現実的な環境が混在する独特の雰囲気のある世界の中、ゆっくりとしたペースで進行します。怪しく、姿を変え続ける家を探索し、真の恐怖をご体験ください。

en.name: Visage
en.description: Visage is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world that combines both uncannily comforting and horrifyingly realistic environments, and enjoy a genuinely terrifying experience.

games.name: Halloween: The Game
games.description: 1978年のハロウィンの夜、誰もマイケル・マイヤーズから逃れることはできない。『ハロウィン』でブギーマンになるか、悪の化身に立ち向かうかはあなた次第だ。

en.name: Halloween: The Game
en.description: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

games.name: メトロ ラストライト リダックス
games.shortName: メトロ ラストライト リダックス
games.description: 時は2034年。終末のモスクワの廃墟、その地下にある地下鉄のトンネルでは、人類の生き残りが外側 – そして内側から恐るべき脅威にさらされている。ミュータントたちが地下では墓地をうろつき、荒廃した地表では毒に侵された空の下狩りをしている。

en.name: METRO Last Light Redux
en.description: It is the year 2034. Beneath the ruins of post-apocalyptic Moscow, in the tunnels of the Metro, the remnants of mankind are besieged by deadly threats from outside – and within. Mutants stalk the catacombs beneath the desolate surface, and hunt amidst the poisoned skies above.

games.name: PANICORE (パニコアー)
games.description: PANICOREは、パーマデス、AIモンスター、協力プレイをミックスしたサバイバルホラーゲームだ。捕まらないように脱出を試みるが、注意：彼らはあなたの足音だけでなく、声も聞いている。

en.name: PANICORE
en.description: PANICORE is a survival horror game that mixes permadeath, AI monsters and a co-op experience up to 5 players (4 players in demo). Try to escape and don't get caught, but beware: they don't only hear your steps, but also your voice.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.shortName: INTO THE DEAD: OUR DARKEST DAYS
games.description: 1980年、テキサス州の街ウォルトンはゾンビで溢れかえっていた。窮地に立たされた生存者となり、物資を集めて装備を整え、安全なシェルターを探して過酷なサバイバルを乗り越えろ。慎重に計画を立て、力を合わせ、決して立ち止まってはならない——この地獄から生還したいのなら。

en.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
en.description: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: メトロ2033 リダックス
games.shortName: メトロ2033 リダックス
games.description: 2013年、世界は終末的な出来事により荒廃した。ほぼ全ての人類は消滅し、地球の地面は有毒な焦土と化してしまった。わずかな生存者たちはモスクワの地下深くへと逃げのび、人類の文明は新たな”闇の時代”へと突入した。時は2033年。

en.name: METRO 2033 Redux
en.description: In 2013 the world was devastated by an apocalyptic event, annihilating almost all mankind and turning the Earth's surface into a poisonous wasteland. A handful of survivors took refuge in the depths of the Moscow underground, and human civilization entered a new Dark Age. The year is 2033.

games.name: The Evil Within 2
games.description: 刑事セバスチャン・カステヤノスは全てを失った――娘リリーも…。救いを得るための唯一の希望は、再び悪夢のようなSTEMの世界に入り込むことだけ。次々と現れる恐ろしい化け物たち。セバスチャンは、その死と隣り合わせの世界で知恵を頼りに生き延びなければなりません。全ては娘を救うために…

en.name: The Evil Within 2
en.description: Detective Sebastian Castellanos has lost everything, including his daughter, Lily. To save her, he must descend into the nightmarish world of STEM. Horrifying threats emerge from every corner, and he must rely on his wits to survive. For his one chance at redemption, the only way out is in.

games.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER
games.description: 『DON’T SCREAM TOGETHER』は、1993年の真っ暗な森を仲間とカメラ片手に歩くオンライン協力型ホラーシミュレーターです。近距離ボイスチャットで協力して脱出を目指そう。ただし誰かが叫ぶとゲームがリスタート、またはハンターとして復活します！

trailers.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER Announcement Teaser Trailer

en.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER
en.description: A very simple co-op jumpscare horror experience where you and friends walk through a pitch black forest and try to stay quiet. Reach 8:00 AM without screaming or making a loud noise, or everyone dies. You will scream, shout, and probably laugh.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
games.description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it's your job to keep an eye on them!

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
en.description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it's your job to keep an eye on them!

games.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
games.description: 新たなサバイバルホラーが目覚める。『Cronos:The New Dawn』荒廃した未来の世界を生き延び、悪夢のように融合するクリーチャーと戦い、人類を滅ぼした黙示録の真相を探るため、時を遡って魂を狩れ。

en.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
en.description: A whole new breed of survival horror emerges with Cronos: The New Dawn. Survive the brutal wastelands of the future, fight nightmarish merging creatures and jump back in time to harvest souls as you seek to uncover the origins of the apocalypse that wiped out humanity.

games.name: The Past Within
games.description: 『The Past Within』は、ラスティレイクがお届けする新しい協力プレイ体験です！信頼できる誰かと一緒にプレイしましょう。それぞれが過去と未来でプレイすることになります。周りをよく観察して、見たものを相手に伝えましょう。パズルを解いて、アルバート・ヴァンダーブームの策略を明らかにしてください。

trailers.name: The Past Within - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

en.name: The Past Within
en.description: The Past Within is the new co-op experience from Rusty Lake! Play together with someone you deem trustworthy: one in The Past, the other in The Future. Observe and communicate what you see around you. Solve the puzzles and uncover Albert Vanderboom’s plan.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
games.description: Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza! As always, Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
en.description: Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza! As always, Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.

games.name: 人喰ノ檻 - KLETKA
games.description: KLETKA(クレトカ)は、君たち囚人を捕食しようとするエレベーターに乗って、地下深くへ降りていく協力型ホラーゲームだ。エレベーターに食べられないよう餌を与え、トラップやモンスターを避け、地下深くまで降りていこう。

en.name: KLETKA
en.description: KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

games.name: The Walking Dead: The Telltale Definitive Series
games.shortName: THE WALKING DEAD: THE TELLTALE DEFINITIV
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
games.description: The Walking Dead: The Telltale Definitive Series contains all 4 Seasons, 400 Days, and The Walking Dead: Michonne, which includes over 50 hours of gameplay across 23 unique episodes.

trailers.name: The Walking Dead: The Telltale Definitive Series - trailer

en.name: The Walking Dead: The Telltale Definitive Series
en.description: The Walking Dead: The Telltale Definitive Series contains all 4 Seasons, 400 Days, and The Walking Dead: Michonne, which includes over 50 hours of gameplay across 23 unique episodes.

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.description: 最大4人の協力プレイで探検家として徒党を組み、財宝を探し求めよう。この呪われし密林にはそこかしこに危険が潜み、モンスターたちが現実を塗り替える。狂気に抗い密林を制覇しなければ、己自身が密林に貪られてしまうのだ…

en.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
en.description: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: Zort
games.description: Zortは、最大4人で遊べるアクション、アドベンチャー、ホラーゲームです。友達と一緒にマップを探索し、さまざまなクリーチャーから逃げながら楽しんでください。ゲーム内のボイスチャットを使用して、友達とリアルなホラー体験を楽しんでください!

en.name: Zort
en.description: Zort is an action, adventure, and horror game that can be played with up to 4 people. Explore maps with your friends and have fun while escaping from various creatures. Experience a realistic horror experience with in-game voice chat with your friends!

games.name: The Headliners
games.description: 協力型ホラーゲームで、1～8人のジャーナリストチームとなり、致命的なクリーチャーに侵略されたニューヨークを探索し、壮大な写真を撮影します。あなたの唯一の目標は、見出しを飾ること...そして、生きてそれを読むことです。

en.name: The Headliners
en.description: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 8 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

games.name: Barotrauma
games.description: 『Barotrauma』は、宇宙サバイバルホラー・潜水艦シュミレーターにRPG要素を加えたの2D協力ゲームです。潜水艦を操作して、ミッションをクリアし、モンスターと戦い、リークを修復して、機械を操作して、銃を使い、アイテムをクラフトします。油断は禁物です：ここでは危険の通知というものが存在しません！

en.name: Barotrauma
en.description: Barotrauma is a 2D co-op submarine simulator – in space, with survival horror and RPG elements. Steer your submarine, complete missions, fight monsters, fix leaks, operate machinery, man the guns and craft items, and stay alert: danger in Barotrauma doesn’t announce itself!

games.name: Little Nightmares II -リトルナイトメア２-
games.shortName: LITTLE NIGHTMARES II -リトルナイトメア２-
games.description: 「Little Nightmares 2」は、サスペンスアドベンチャーゲームです。プレイヤーは主人公の少年「モノ」となって、怪電波によって歪められた世界をさまよい、新たな友『シックス』と共に電波の発信源を探すことになります。

en.name: Little Nightmares II
en.description: Little Nightmares II is the second game in a series that has thrilled and captivated millions of players worldwide since 2017. Now it’s your turn to try to survive this critically acclaimed entry in the most charming horror series ever made.

games.name: Painkiller Hell & Damnation
games.description: Evil has returned! Demonic powers are manifesting themselves as a myriad of dark creatures, fighting over the fates of imprisoned souls caught in Purgatory.

en.name: Painkiller Hell & Damnation
en.description: Evil has returned! Demonic powers are manifesting themselves as a myriad of dark creatures, fighting over the fates of imprisoned souls caught in Purgatory.

games.name: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: HELP WANTED
games.shortName: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: HELP WANTED
games.description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted is a collection of classic and original mini-games set in the Five Nights universe. Experience the horror in flat (non-VR) mode or VR. Oculus Rift and HTC Vive are supported. A VR Headset is NOT required to play.

en.name: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: HELP WANTED
en.description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted is a collection of classic and original mini-games set in the Five Nights universe. Experience the horror in flat (non-VR) mode or VR. Oculus Rift and HTC Vive are supported. A VR Headset is NOT required to play.

games.name: [Chilla's Art] The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件
games.description: 夜勤事件は、コンビニの夜勤で働く女子大生に関するJホラーゲームです。

en.name: [Chilla's Art] The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件
en.description: The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件 is a J-horror game about a college girl on a night shift.

games.name: At Dead Of Night
games.description: At Dead Of Night is part horror film, part horror game and part ghost hunt. It blends live-action and graphics to create a unique immersive horror experience like no other.

en.name: At Dead Of Night
en.description: At Dead Of Night is part horror film, part horror game and part ghost hunt. It blends live-action and graphics to create a unique immersive horror experience like no other.

games.name: The Complex: Expedition
games.description: When a routine expedition into The Complex goes horribly wrong, you're left alone and lost, wandering the seemingly infinite maze of hallways, otherwise known as the Backrooms. Might there be something following you?

trailers.name: THE COMPLEX: EXPEDITION - Official Full Release Trailer

en.name: The Complex: Expedition
en.description: When a routine expedition into The Complex goes horribly wrong, you're left alone and lost, wandering the seemingly infinite maze of hallways, otherwise known as the Backrooms. Might there be something following you?

games.name: DON'T SCREAM
games.description: 叫んだら即終了。2人の作者により、Unreal Engine 5を駆使して開発された短編ホラゲー。クリア条件は、なんと「叫ばずに18分間森を探索する」…だけ？と思いきや、「時間が経過するのは移動中のみ」という特別ルールあり。お友達やご家族を徹底的にビビらせたい方は必見！プレイにはマイクが必須です！

en.name: DON'T SCREAM
en.description: If you scream, you restart. A jumpscare horror simulator where you walk through a pitch black forest and escape by reaching 8:00 AM.

games.name: 殺戮の天使
games.description: 「お願い、私を殺して」「一緒にここから出る手助けをしてくれよ。そしたらお前を、殺してやるよ」 『殺戮の天使』はエピソード1からエピソード4の4部構成からなるサイコホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。

en.name: Angels of Death
en.description: "Please... kill me." "Help me get outta here, and I'll kill you." ~ Angels of Death is a psychological horror-adventure game, consisting of four episodes.

games.name: KinitoPET
games.description: KinitoPET is a psychological horror experience that takes place through Kinito, an early 2000s virtual assistant. Kinito is able to walk, talk, browse, adapt, and play games as Kinito is like no other with its adaptive technology!

en.name: KinitoPET
en.description: KinitoPET is a psychological horror experience that takes place through Kinito, an early 2000s virtual assistant. Kinito is able to walk, talk, browse, adapt, and play games as Kinito is like no other with its adaptive technology!

games.name: Granny
games.description: You have to escape Granny`s house...You have five days...

en.name: Granny
en.description: You have to escape Granny`s house...You have five days...

games.name: Dark Hours
games.description: 『Dark Hours』は、1～4人でプレイする協力型サバイバルホラーゲーム。あなたは超自然的な出来事に強盗の邪魔をされ、チームメイトは邪悪な存在に捕らえられてしまう。計画のことは忘れて、生き残ることが先決だ。出口を見つけために、仲間と協力して探索しよう。

en.name: Dark Hours
en.description: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out.

games.name: The Mortuary Assistant
games.description: 隣り合わせの死…。遺体をエンバームして悪霊を追い払い、自身の魂を守れ。

en.name: The Mortuary Assistant
en.description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

games.name: うみねこのなく頃に
games.description: 【うみねこのなく頃に】本作品は日本語モード、英語モードを搭載したサウンドノベルです。物語の前編となるＥＰ１～４が収録されています。

en.name: Umineko When They Cry - Question Arcs
en.description: Umineko When They Cry is the 2nd series of Sound Novel released by 07th Expansion. The steam version features renewed character sprites which is swappable from the classic art.

games.name: 恐怖の世界
games.description: 怪異とのバトル、そして容赦のない選択肢が紡ぎ出す、地獄のようなローグライトRPG。本作は、伊藤潤二氏とH.P. Lovecraft氏へ捧げる1ビットのラブレターである。プレイするたび変化する悪夢のような出会いが、不可解な事件を解き明かすカギとなる。謎の先に待つものは…

en.name: WORLD OF HORROR
en.description: Experience the quiet terror of this 1-bit love letter to Junji Ito and H.P. Lovecraft. Navigate a hellish roguelite reality with turn-based combat and unforgiving choices. Experiment with your deck of event cards to discover new forms of cosmic horror in every playthrough. The inevitable awaits...

games.name: Detention
games.description: 1960年代の台湾、架空世界の学校を舞台にしたホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。台湾ならではの文化を表現したいため、キャラクターやシーンも台湾人に親しみのある要素を採用しており、一膳飯、廟宇、神壇など、当時の宗教や風習をゲームに組み込んでいます。

en.name: Detention
en.description: Detention is an atmospheric horror game set in 1960s Taiwan under martial law. Incorporated religious elements based in Taiwanese/Chinese culture and mythology, the game provided players with unique graphics and gaming experience.

games.name: Lunch Lady
games.description: Lunch Lady は、1～4人でプレイできるオンライン協力型サバイバルホラーゲームです。学校の期末試験が迫るなか、あなたと友達が思いついた最高のアイデアは「試験の答案を盗むこと」。答案10ページをすべて見つけ出し、殺人鬼の給食おばさん「ランチレディ」に捕まらないように逃げ切りましょう！

en.name: Lunch Lady
en.description: Lunch Lady is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. The school final exams are coming up and the best idea you and your friends had was to steal the test answers. Find all 10 pages and don't get caught by the murderous Lunch Lady!

games.name: Demonologist
games.description: Demonologistは、最低1人、最大4人で遊べるCo-Opホラーゲームです。呪われた場所にいる悪霊の種類を特定し、装備を駆使して悪霊を祓うことが目的です、一人でもチームでも楽しめます。

en.name: Demonologist
en.description: Demonologist is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. Your goal is to identify the type of evil spirit in cursed places and exorcise it using your equipment, either alone or with your team.

games.name: We Were Here Too
games.description: 最期の時が近づき、はるか遠く、激しい嵐の中にそびえる巨大な城。コミュニケーションを活用するcoopアドベンチャーで城に潜む闇の真実を暴き出そう。

trailers.name: We Were Here - Too  | Official Release Trailer
We Were Here - Too | Official Gameplay Trailer
We Were Here - Too | Official Trailer

en.name: We Were Here Too
en.description: As your final hour approaches, a large structure looms up in the distance, towering above the relentless storm. Discover the truth behind this dark castle in a communication-based, cooperative puzzle adventure.

games.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
games.description: 自分の体験と『Fears to Fathom』のあるエピソードの間にある背筋が凍るような類似点に気づいたテッサとマーカスは、自分たちのエピソードを共有することにした。『Scratch Creek』は、オンライン限定の協力プレイ専用タイトルだ。

en.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
en.description: After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of Fears to Fathom, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience. Scratch Creek is an exclusively online co-op experience.

games.name: Look Outside
games.description: これは、アパートの一室から始まるサバイバルホラーRPG。謎だらけの出来事によって、窓の外を見た者はグロテスクな化け物へと姿を変えられ、世界を本物の混沌へと陥れる。建物の中を調べ回って食糧、物資、武器を探し出せ。そして奇妙な者たちと出会うことになるだろう。

en.name: Look Outside
en.description: Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters.

games.name: Slay the Princess — The Pristine Cut
games.shortName: SLAY THE PRINCESS — THE PRISTINE CUT
games.description: 君はプリンセスを倒すためにここにいる。彼女の嘘を信じてはならない。

en.name: Slay the Princess — The Pristine Cut
en.description: You're here to slay the princess. Don't believe her lies.

games.name: biohazard 0 HD REMASTER
games.description: シリーズ累計販売本数6,500万本を超える『バイオハザード』シリーズ。 その出発点である「洋館事件」の始まりが描かれた作品「biohazard 0」をHDリマスター化。 秘められた恐怖と謎を、あなた自身で体験してもらいたい。 【イーライセンス利用許諾番号】ID34094

en.name: Resident Evil 0
en.description: Before the mansion, before the destruction of Raccoon City, there was Resident Evil 0. Now remastered with improved visuals and sounds, as well as the all-new Wesker Mode, there's never been a better time to experience the origins of the Resident Evil story.

games.name: Endacopia
games.description: Endacopia is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

en.name: Endacopia
en.description: Endacopia is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

games.name: BIOHAZARD 2 (1998)
games.description: はじめての任務に向かう途中で大事件に巻き込まれた新人警官の「レオン・Ｓ・ケネディ」と、音信不通となった兄を捜す「クレア・レッドフィールド」の物語が個別に展開。最新の3Dアクセラレーテッドグラフィックスが、リアルな恐怖体験を呼び起こす。

en.name: Resident Evil 2 (1998)
en.description: Command Leon S. Kennedy, a rookie cop who stumbles onto the carnage reporting for his first duty, or play as Claire Redfield, desperately searching for her missing brother. Cutting edge 3-D accelerated graphics that create a terrifying, photo-realistic experience.

games.name: Carnival Hunt
games.description: Carnival Huntは、5対1の一人称視点非対称ホラーゲーム。5体のぜんまい仕掛けのウサギは、音を立てる鍵を管理し、姿を変えるカーニバルから協力して脱出しなければならない。もう1人のプレイヤーはカーニバル・モンスターとなり、彼らを狩る。

en.name: Carnival Hunt
en.description: Carnival Hunt is a 5v1 first-person asymmetrical horror game. Five wind-up Bunnies must work together, manage their noisy keys, and find a way to escape an ever-changing carnival world while one player hunts them as the Carnival Monster.

games.name: Emissary Zero
games.description: 協力型ホラー (1～4 人用)。夜に謎の建物を探索するよう命じられます。月を見つけて、生きて帰れるように努力しましょう。

en.name: Emissary Zero
en.description: Co-op horror (1-4 players). You are sent to explore a mysterious building at night. Find the Moon and try to return alive.

games.name: Mad Father (マッドファーザー)
games.shortName: MAD FATHER (マッドファーザー)
games.description: あなたが見届けるのは、愚かな家族の物語。 名作と名高い探索型ホラーゲームのリメイク版が登場。

en.name: Mad Father
en.description: Witness the tale of a most foolish family. A remake of the classic horror exploration game makes its way to Steam.

games.name: The Painscreek Killings
games.description: ペインスクリークキリングスは、かつておきた未解決事件を紐解いていく、一人称視点のストーリーリッチ・ミステリーゲームです。町に秘められたダークな秘密を明らかにし、隠された真実にたどり着くことがあなたにはできますか？

en.name: The Painscreek Killings
en.description: Investigate an infamous cold case in the eerie, abandoned town of Painscreek. Search for evidence, connect the dots and uncover who killed Vivian Roberts. Can you expose the truth behind this town’s dark secrets?

games.name: Among the Sleep - Enhanced Edition
games.description: Among the Sleep: Enhanced Edition is a new and improved version of the award winning first person horror adventure. In the game you play as a small child trapped in a weird nightmare where you go looking for your mom.

trailers.name: Among the Sleep - Enhanced Edition Trailer

en.name: Among the Sleep - Enhanced Edition
en.description: Among the Sleep: Enhanced Edition is a new and improved version of the award winning first person horror adventure. In the game you play as a small child trapped in a weird nightmare where you go looking for your mom.

games.name: 魔女の家MV
games.description: 少女ヴィオラは、森の中にたたずむ謎めいた館へと容赦なく引き寄せられている。そこは痛みと混乱、そして死の場所である。その憎むべき闇と忌まわしい過去を調べよ。君の行く手を阻む謎を解け。そして魔女の家の地獄のような空間から逃げ出そう。

en.name: The Witch's House MV
en.description: A young girl, Viola, is drawn inexorably to a mysterious manor that seems to change behind her back. It is a place of pain, turmoil and death. Plumb its detestable depths and abominable history. Untangle riddles that bar your perilous path. And flee the hellish halls of The Witch’s House.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
games.description: Thirty years after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza closed it's doors, the events that took place there have become nothing more than a rumor and a childhood memory, but the owners of "Fazbear's Fright: The Horror Attraction" are determined to revive the legend and make the experience as authentic as possible for patrons, going to great lengths to find anything that might have survived decades of neglect and ruin. At first there were only empty shells, a hand, a hook, an old paper-plate doll, but then a remarkable discovery was made... The attraction now has one animatronic.

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
en.description: Thirty years after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza closed it's doors, the events that took place there have become nothing more than a rumor and a childhood memory, but the owners of "Fazbear's Fright: The Horror Attraction" are determined to revive the legend and make the experience as authentic as possible for patrons, going to great lengths to find anything that might have survived decades of neglect and ruin. At first there were only empty shells, a hand, a hook, an old paper-plate doll, but then a remarkable discovery was made... The attraction now has one animatronic.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
games.description: In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows.

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
en.description: In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows.

games.name: MOLE
games.description: 戦後に生まれた超巨大掘削艇「モール」を操縦し、潜るはスラヴの地の底。機能不全に陥るシステムを修理し、死者の声に耳を澄まし、そして自らの無事を祈れ──この棺には、“何か”がいる…… 先にコワれるのは機体か、精神か。

en.name: MOLE
en.description: Pilot the MOLE, a monstrous post-war drilling machine built to descend deep below the Slavic soil. Fix failing systems, follow voices of the dead, and pray you can survive whatever is sharing your coffin. Will the vessel or your mind break first?

games.name: From The Darkness
games.description: From the darkness is a psychological horror game with a scary atmosphere, the game takes place in an old Soviet abandoned apartment.

en.name: From The Darkness
en.description: From the darkness is a psychological horror game with a scary atmosphere, the game takes place in an old Soviet abandoned apartment.

games.name: ヨグ=ソトースの庭
genres: 恋愛シミュレーション
games.description: 「死神」「ドラゴン」「斬霊師」「人造メイド」——個性豊かでキュートなスタッフたちを雇って、負債を抱えたホテルを経営しよう！採掘や冒険・錬金術・レストラン経営etc……多彩な手段で富を築いて、目指すは借金返済！人外スタッフたちとの恋愛模様が魅力の、ホテル経営シム×恋愛ADV！

trailers.name: 公開日決定プロモーションJa

en.name: Yog-Sothoth’s Yard
en.description: Manage a hotel and hire employees including Death, a dragon, a Spirit Hunter, and a bioroid maid. Build your wealth through various means and refine your strategies based on the predictions of Oracles. All employees can be romanced depending on your choices.

games.name: Who's Lila?
genres: 選択方式アドベンチャー
games.description: A reverse-detective adventure, where you control your character's face

en.name: Who's Lila?
en.description: A reverse-detective adventure, where you control your character's face

games.name: In Silence
games.description: In Silenceはマルチプレイヤーホラーゲームです。一人のプレーヤーは、過敏な聴覚能力を持ち、ほぼ完全に盲目のモンスターの役割を引き受けます。他のプレイヤー（2-6）は生存者として、モンスターを脱出または狩猟しようとします。

en.name: In Silence
en.description: In Silence is a multiplayer horror game. One player takes on the role of the monster who has hypersensitive hearing abilities and is almost completely blind. The other players(2-6) play as survivors, trying to escape or hunting the monster.

games.name: Species: Unknown
games.description: Species: Unknownは1～4人協力プレイ対応のサバイバルホラーです。廃墟となった船で未知の生物に追われながら、危険なミッションを遂行しましょう。生き残り、装備を強化して暗闇に潜む新たな恐怖に立ち向かいましょう。

en.name: Species: Unknown
en.description: Species: Unknown is a 1 to 4 players co-op survival horror. Complete high-risk missions aboard an abandoned ship while being hunted by an unknown creature. Survive and upgrade your gear to face each new threat that lurks in the dark.

games.name: Murky Divers
games.description: ソロまたは最大8人のプレイヤー。放棄された水中研究所から、雇い主の失敗した実験の痕跡を消去しなければならない。潜水艦を操縦し、深淵の恐ろしいものを避けつつ、全ての死体を排除しよう。

en.name: Murky Divers
en.description: Solo or up to 8 players. Get rid of your employer's failed experiments in abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, avoid abyssal terrors, and remove all corpses.

games.name: Pacify
games.description: PAH社のために超自然的な生物を鎮め、弱体化させ、捕獲するオンライン協力型ホラーゲームです。各ステージには異なるストーリー、ユニークなモンスター、そして複数のエンディングが用意されています。シングルプレイはもちろん、最大6人の友達と一緒にプレイすることも可能です。楽しいエフェクト付きの近接ボイスチャット機能も搭載されています。

trailers.name: Pacify - New Scary Horror Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Pacify
en.description: An online co-op horror game where you pacify, weaken and capture supernatural creatures for PAH Inc. Each level has a different story, unique monsters, and multiple endings. Play single player or together with up to 6 friends. Includes proximity voice chat with fun effects.

games.name: Paper Dolls: Original / 纸人
games.developer: Beijing Litchi Culture Media Co., Ltd.
games.description: 『帋人形（カミニンギョウ）』は中国文化を背景とする一人称ホラーゲーム。うつ病を持つ主人公の「楊 明遠」は、車の運転中に事故に遭い、清朝末期に建てられた不気味な館で目を覚ました。行方不明になった娘を探すために館中に彷徨った楊は、この百年を経た館に、誰でも知らなかった怖い真実と出会った。

en.name: Paper Dolls: Original / 纸人
en.description: Paper Dolls Original is a first-person horror adventure game steeped in Eastern culture. You act a man who is separated from his daughter after a car accident. When he awakes, he finds himself in a deserted Asian mansion. Find your daughter and unveil a terrifying story buried for a hundred years

games.name: House

en.name: House

games.name: That's not my Neighbor
games.description: 1955年、何らかの理由でドッペルゲンガーが通常より多く見られるようになっています。そのため、ドッペルゲンガー検出局（D.D.D.）が対策を講じました。 あなたはアパートの管理人で、自分の隣人だと主張する人を通すかどうかを判断する必要があります。

en.name: That's not my Neighbor
en.description: It's 1955, and for unknown reasons, doppelgangers are more common than usual. Therefore, the Department of Doppelganger Detection (D.D.D.) has taken action. You are the doorman of an apartment complex, and you must decide whether to let in those who claim to be your neighbors.

games.name: Emily Wants To Play
games.description: Emily Wants to Playは、戦略要素のある怖いサバイバルホラーゲームです。あなたは、エミリーと彼女の3つの人形によって捕捉されるピザの配達人として再生されます。人形は生きていて、彼らはあなたと一緒に家を歩き回っています。

trailers.name: Emily Wants To Play Official Trailer
Emily Wants To Play GamePlay Teaser

en.name: Emily Wants To Play
en.description: It’s 11pm and the last house on your route. The windows are boarded up, the yard is overgrown, but the lights are on and the front door is open… strange place to deliver a pizza. You’re getting soaked from the rain, so you hesitantly step inside the house. You shouldn’t have done that.

games.name: Ravenous Devils
games.description: 犯罪を隠し味にした、ホラークッキングシミュレーター。お店を改善して、新しい道具を買って、メニューを増やして、何よりも、お客さんに喜んでもらいましょう。

trailers.name: Ravenous Devils Trailer - Horror Cooking Simulator

en.name: Ravenous Devils
en.description: A horror cooking simulator where the secret ingredient is crime. Improve your shops, buy new tools, expand your menu, and above all, make your customers happy.

trailers.name: I'm on Observation Duty trailer Update 1.1

en.name: I'm on Observation Duty
