en.description: PlinkIdle is a retro-inspired game with an idle/incremental spin on a classic ball drop mechanic. Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

floor2.name: パーリングマン

floor2.name: Die After Sunset
floor2.description: Die After Sunsetは、光と闇を特徴としたユニークなメカニズムを備える、3人称視点のアクションローグライトシューターです。地球のために戦い、時を越えて、敵の大群を倒し、ランダムなクエストをこなして、最高のビルドを作り上げていきます。あなたはミュルコールの侵攻に隠された謎を解くことができるでしょうか？

en.name: Die After Sunset

Go online, one on one: take the wheel of the tanker that survived and deliver the fuel, or pilot the FPV drone and make sure IT never arrives. And it's all in PS1 style. Weather favors the operator, smoke and a jammer favor the driver.

floor2.shortName: おいでませ、みなみ通りへ！
genres: 人生シミュレーション
floor2.description: おいでませ、みなみ通りへ！ 自分だけの町なみを作れる、カジュアルでのんびりした経営シミュレーションです！ 建物をアンロック&カスタマイズしたり、村のみんなにめいっぱいたのしんでもらえる場所を作ってクエストをこなし、通りに愛をあふれさせましょう！

en.name: Minami Lane
en.description: Welcome to Minami Lane! Build your own street in this tiny cozy, casual management sim! Unlock and customize buildings, manage your shops, and maximize the happiness of your villagers to complete quests and fill your street with love!

floor2.name: Project Highrise
floor2.description: Project Highrise is a skyscraper construction and management sim...

en.name: Project Highrise
en.description: Project Highrise is a skyscraper construction and management sim...

floor2.name: カブトパーク
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
floor2.description: カブトパークでのひと夏を楽しもう！ かわいいムシをつかまえてレベルアップするコレクションゲーム。集めたムシで夏のムシバトルを勝ち抜いちゃえ！ もっとレアで、強くて、色違いのミクロな友だちと出会いたければ、装備のアップグレードも忘れずに。

en.name: Kabuto Park
en.description: Enjoy summer in Kabuto Park! Catch the cutest bugs, train them and win the Summer Beetle Battles Championship in this tiny bug collection game! Upgrade your equipment to find rarer, stronger and shinier little friends.

floor2.name: No Time to Relax
floor2.description: 『リラックスしてらんない』はオンライン対戦にも対応した対戦人生シミュレーションゲームである。プレイヤーはCPUやオンライン上の最大3プレイヤーを相手に、出世をしつつも勉学に励み、さらに理性を保たなければならない。

en.name: No Time to Relax
en.description: No Time to Relax is a life simulation game where up to 4 players online or locally compete against each other in the ultimate game of life.

floor2.name: Climber Animals: Together
floor2.description: Climber Animalsは、1〜8人のプレイヤー向けの挑戦的でダイナミックなパルクールゲームです。このゲームでは、障害物を乗り越えて友達と一緒に頂上を目指します。転んだら、進行が失われて最初からやり直しです。この難しい登りをバランスを保ちながら、友達と競って頂上に到達しましょう。

en.name: Climber Animals: Together
en.description: Climber Animals is a challenging and dynamic parkour game for 1-8 players. In this game,overcome obstacles and climb to the top with your friends. If you fall, your progress is lost and you start over. Keep your balance on this challenging climb and compete with your friends to reach the top.

floor2.name: Rocket Rats
floor2.description: 『Rocket Rats』は宇宙に行って、チーズでできた天体を倒すサバイバー系ゲームだ。主人公はネズミ！敵の大群を撃退し、チーズを集め、装備を強化して、月を征服しよう！

en.name: Rocket Rats
en.description: Rocket Rats is a survivors-like game where you defeat cheese-based astral bodies in space – as a rat! Clear waves of enemies, collect cheese, upgrade your gear, and conquer the moon!

floor2.name: MyVoiceZoo
floor2.description: My Voice Zoo は、あなたの声で完成する放置型動物園ゲームです。 マイクで録音した声が動物たちの鳴き声になり、 世界にひとつだけの動物園を作り上げましょう！

en.name: MyVoiceZoo
en.description: My Voice Zoo is a unique idle zoo game brought to life with your own voice. Record your sounds through the microphone and turn them into animal calls, creating a one-of-a-kind zoo found nowhere else. Start building your very own zoo, complete only with your voice!

floor2.name: Pilgrims (ピルグリム)
floor2.description: Pilgrims（ピルグリム）は、Machinarium（マシナリウム）とSamorost（サモロスト）の制作陣が贈る、愉快なアドベンチャーゲームです。人々を喜ばせたり友達を作りながら島を探索して、旅仲間たちと笑い合い、彼らにまつわる小さな物語を一緒に紐解いていきましょう。果たしてあなたは、どれだけの解決策を見いだせるでしょうか？

en.name: Pilgrims
en.description: Pilgrims is a playful adventure game, created by the team behind Machinarium and Samorost. Roam the land as you please and make new friends, share a laugh with your fellow travelers and help them complete their little stories, your way. How many different solutions can you find?

floor2.name: ロプカのゆったりとした島
floor2.shortName: ロプカのゆったりとした島
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
floor2.description: 「ロプカのゆったりとした島」デスクトップ上の、居心地の良いゲーム。あなたが仕事をしたり、リラックスしたりしている間、カエルは道具をアップグレードしたり、草を刈ったり、島を飾ったりします！

en.name: Ropuka's Idle Island
en.description: A cozy idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Watch the frog cut grass, upgrade his tools, and decorate the island while you work or relax.

floor2.name: Anomaly Agent
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
floor2.description: 『Anomaly Agent』は、サイバーパンク2Dアクションゲームです。プレイヤーは80年代のレトロなシンセウェーブ音楽に囲まれながら、時間と空間を超えた冒険に挑み、様々な奇妙な敵と戦い、世界が完全に混沌に陥る前にすべてを救うことになります。

en.name: Anomaly Agent
en.description: ANOMALY AGENT is a cyberpunk action-adventure featuring fluid combat, a time-bending story, quirky characters and a catchy synthwave soundtrack! Punch or shoot through mobs of enemies, impact the story with your choices and stop the anomalies before the world plunges into chaos!

floor2.name: klocki
floor2.description: 線をつなぐ、心安らぐミニマルパズル。広告なし、時間制限なし、スコアなし。

en.name: klocki
en.description: A relaxing puzzle about connecting lines. No ads, no timers, no pressure.

floor2.name: Rising Storm 2: Vietnam
floor2.description: Red Orchestraシリーズ、ベトナム編。64人製のマルチプレイモードを搭載。収録マップ20種類以上。米国軍・海兵隊、北ベトナム軍、ベトコン、オーストラリア軍、ベトナム共和国陸軍が登場。50種類以上の武器と4種のヘリ、地雷、罠、トンネルを利用可能。無慈悲で、本格的、骨太な戦闘を再現。キャラクターをカスタマイズ可能。ナパームの香りが漂う朝を生き延びろ。

trailers.name: Rising Storm 2: Vietnam - Launch Trailer (Full Version)
Rising Storm 2: Vietnam - Green Army Men Beach Party 2019
Rising Storm 2: Vietnam - Multiplayer Campaign Trailer

en.name: Rising Storm 2: Vietnam
en.description: Red Orchestra Series' take on Vietnam: 64-player MP matches; 20+ maps; US Army & Marines, PAVN/NVA, NLF/VC; Australians and ARVN forces; 50+ weapons; 4 flyable helicopters; mines, traps and tunnels; Brutal. Authentic. Gritty. Character customization. And napalm in the morning.

floor2.name: Zero Escape: Zero Time Dilemma
floor2.description: 『その記憶（いのち）は90分で消滅する― 極限脱出アドベンチャー』 目覚めると９人の男女は監禁室の中にいた、左の手首には見覚えのない黒いバングル。 そこに仮面をつけた謎の人物が姿を現わし、全人類80億人の命を賭けた『Decisionゲーム』の開始を宣言する。

trailers.name: アナウンストレーラー

en.name: Zero Escape: Zero Time Dilemma
en.description: Nine participants awaken, trapped in an underground facility. To escape, they must play a game with deadly consequences. Who will live, and who will die? The choice is yours. Let the Decision Game begin…

floor2.name: Post Void
floor2.description: 『POST VOID』は催眠がかった世界で混戦を繰り広げる、スピードを最重視した草創期的な一人称視点シューティングゲームです。頭をフル回転させて最後までたどり着け。何もかもをキルして苦痛から逃れろ。ハイスコアを出せなければやり直せ。

en.name: Post Void
en.description: Post Void is a hypnotic scramble of early first-person shooter design that values speed above all else. Keep your head full and reach the end; Kill what you can to see it mend; Get the high score or try again.

floor2.name: Cats Organized Neatly
floor2.description: この2Dパズルゲームではねこの友達をピッタリとつめる役目があります。80の手作りステージと様々な形や大きさのねこがいっぱいます。

en.name: Cats Organized Neatly
en.description: In this 2D puzzle game you have the responsibility to arrange your feline friends in a way that fits the grid. Cats Organized Neatly comes with 80 different handcrafted levels and a whole bunch of cats in all shapes and sizes.

floor2.name: LoveChoice 択愛
genres: 恋愛シミュレーション
floor2.description: 「愛するって、どうすればいいだろう？」という質問に、私たちはこのゲームで答えてみました。選択を真剣に考えて選ぶことで、プレイヤーは愛について考えるように設計されたアドベンチャーゲームです。

en.name: LoveChoice
en.description: "What is love?" We try to answer that with this game. The game encourages people to have a warm, soft, and understanding heart.

floor2.name: Seraph's Last Stand
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
floor2.description: Create insane builds and break the game in all possible ways to get your name into the leaderboards! Every round you get stronger, but so does the enemies...

en.name: Seraph's Last Stand
en.description: Create insane builds and break the game in all possible ways to get your name into the leaderboards! Every round you get stronger, but so does the enemies...

floor2.name: Prickle
floor2.description: この健全なグリッドベースのパズルで、ハリネズミのお父さんとなり、とげのある子供たちを家に連れて帰る冒険に挑戦しましょう。

en.name: Prickle
en.description: Play father hedgehog on a quest to bring his prickly children back home, in this wholesome grid-based puzzle.

floor2.name: AMPANIC
floor2.description: 「エイム力」×「繁忙」 “エイム力” と"判断力"が試される店さばきゲーム 素材収集、加工、調合、接客―― すべてを「エイム」でこなす超高速ショップキーパー。効率と対応の順番を考えながら常にベストなパフォーマンスを出しましょう。3段階難易度調整でマウス初心者から熟練者まで！オンラインcoop , オンライン対戦に対応

en.name: AMPANIC
en.description: A hyper-fast shopkeeping game where every task is performed with your aim! Keep performing at your best by thinking carefully about efficiency and task order. Three difficulty levels, from mouse beginners to seasoned experts! Online co-op and versus multiplayer supported.

floor2.name: 小さなバードトピア
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
floor2.description: 『小さなバードトピア』でサンクチュアリを建設・運営。多様な鳥を集めて育成し、自然へ還しつつ羽を集めて隠し種を解放。森や島のテーマで保護区をカスタマイズし、放置ゲームで鳥たちの成長を見守ろう。

en.name: Tiny Birdtopia
en.description: This is not Bird Game 3! Build and manage a relaxing bird sanctuary. Collect and raise diverse bird species, and unlock hidden species by gathering feathers. Customize your Birdtopia with themes like forests and islands, and watch your birds thrive in this casual, idle game.

floor2.name: 決戦は来週!
floor2.description: 「決戦は来週！」は、7日以内に魔王から村を守る方法を見つけ出す選択型アドベンチャーパズルゲームです。 1週間のあいだ、小さな村をあちこち歩き回り、雑談し、説得し、取引し、発見することで村を守りましょう！

en.name: Showdown next week!
en.description: "Showdown next week!" is a choice-based adventure puzzle game where you must find a way to protect your village from the Demon King within seven days. For one week, wander around the small village—chatting, persuading, trading, and discovering—to explore different ways to defend it!

floor2.name: Probo Rush
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
floor2.description: Probo Rushは、ボスラッシュの捻りを加えたレトロなシューティング・弾幕ゲームです。機械や宇宙人、自然と闘いながらボスバトル10戦に挑んでいきます。Probo Rushは、HPが調整可能でアシストモードもあるので、やりがいがありつつも気軽に挑戦できます。

en.name: Probo Rush
en.description: Probo Rush is a classic shoot 'em up bullet hell game with a boss rush twist. Fight against machines, aliens, and nature as you take on 15 challenging boss battles. With adjustable health and an Assist Mode, Probo Rush offers a challenging but accessible gaming experience.

floor2.name: Pidgeon Pocket
floor2.description: かわいいピクセルアートでまったり遊べる、ほっこりインクリメンタル。あり得ないほど愛らしいハトの群れで、にぎやかな公園を狙ってコインを持ち帰り、アップグレードに使いましょう。 どのハトにも専用のスーパーパワーがあります。飛んで、集めて、強化して。

en.name: Pidgeon Pocket
en.description: A cozy incremental with beautiful pixel art and a flock of adorable pigeons. Aim at a busy park, bring the coins home and spend them on upgrades. Every pigeon gets its own superpower. Swoop, collect, upgrade.

floor2.name: おててタマゴ
floor2.description: おててタマゴとは、２本の手が生えた感情豊かなタマゴ…つまりこのゲームをするあなたのことです 友達と協力したり対戦したり、足を引っ張りあったり（おててタマゴに足はないけど）して楽しみましょう！

trailers.name: アーリーアクセス予告_jp

en.name: Two Hands Eggs
en.description: Two Hands Egg is an emotional egg with two hands...that is, you who play this game. Have fun cooperating with your friends, competing against each other.

floor2.name: Boltz
floor2.description: Boltz は、画面上のターゲットとなるすべてのボルトとナットを取り除く、ミニマリストなロジックパズルゲームです。約10レベルごとに追加される新しいギミックにより、奥深いパズル体験を楽しめます。

en.name: Boltz
en.description: Boltz is a minimalist logic puzzle where you try to remove all the target bolts and nuts on the screen. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new mechanics added approximately every 10 levels.

floor2.name: Solaris
floor2.description: 「ソラリス」は、自分自身を探す旅の物語です。主人公は愛する人の最期の願いを叶えるため、奇妙で滑稽な多くのキャラクターたちと出会います。道中はユーモアにあふれていますが、進むほどに、心地よい表面の下で何か古く恐ろしいものが目を覚まそうとしているのを強く感じます。

en.name: Solaris
en.description: "Solaris" is a story about a journey in search of yourself. The hero fulfills the last will of a loved one, meeting many strange characters. The road is full of humor, but the further you go, the stronger the feeling becomes: beneath the cozy surface, something terrible is awakening.

floor2.name: Project: AFTERSHOCK
floor2.description: システムを構築したのはお前だ。今度はそれを破壊しろ。 Project: AFTERSHOCKは、ディストピアな未来を舞台にした物語主導型のアーケードハッキング・ローグライトです。忘れ去られたバンカーからレジーム（体制）のファイアウォールを突破し、真実を暴き、汚名を晴らしてください。

en.name: Project: AFTERSHOCK
en.description: Project: AFTERSHOCK is a fast-paced arcade hacking roguelite set in a dystopian future. Command a 20-year-old legacy terminal to breach enemy systems, siphon funds, and upgrade your hardware. Use your reflexes to survive the countdown and bring down the very system you created.

floor2.name: もっともっとトウモロコシ
floor2.shortName: もっともっとトウモロコシ
genres: 農場シミュレーション
floor2.description: トラクターの農機を長く伸ばして、もっと多くのトウモロコシを収穫しましょう。レアなトウモロコシを集めて、報酬を手に入れましょう。

en.name: Never Enough Corn
en.description: Extend your tractor equipment to harvest more corn. Collect rare corn and earn rewards.

floor2.name: Cosmo Cat: A Cozy Desktop Idler
floor2.shortName: COSMO CAT: A COZY DESKTOP IDLER
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
floor2.description: 宇宙を漂う自分だけの猫と時間を過ごし、一日の記録を星座として残していく、心温まるデスクトップ放置ゲーム。

en.name: Cosmo Cat: A Cozy Desktop Idler
en.description: An emotional desktop idle game where you spend time with your own cat floating through space and record your day as constellations.

floor2.name: 朝餉
floor2.description: 青緑色の森で朝ご飯を作る、手描きアニメーションで描かれる短編アドベンチャー。マップ上であなたにできることは祈ることだけ。森の住人の力を借りながら、少し奇妙なミニゲームを通して「朝餉」を完成させましょう。

en.name: ASAGE
en.description: A short hand-drawn adventure set in a serene blue-green forest. The only thing you can do on the world map is pray. Meet the forest's residents and complete a traditional Japanese breakfast known as Asage through a series of charming, slightly strange minigames.

floor2.name: 名画ジグソー
floor2.description: 名画を少しずつ組み立てる、くつろぎのジグソーパズル。難易度を選び、自分の画像でパズルを作ることもできます。進行状況の保存やタイマーの非表示に対応。絵画を完成させて、作品を紹介する図鑑ページを解放しましょう。

en.name: Cozy Jigsaw
en.description: Unwind with 300+ paintings in the base game, solo or with friends online. Create jigsaws from your own images, try irregular-shaped puzzle challenges, and export videos of your puzzling process. Choose your difficulty and piece together art at your own pace.

floor2.name: Terranny
floor2.description: ドローンを設計およびプログラムし、自律戦闘に送り込みます。この「カルネージハート」にインスパイアされたゲームで論理を試してください。

en.name: Terranny
en.description: Design and program drones, then send them into autonomous battles. Test your logic in this "Carnage Heart" (カルネージハート) inspired game.

floor2.name: A Personal Winter
floor2.description: 雪の降る街で、少年と先輩が過ごす一夜を描いた短編ノベルゲーム

en.name: A Personal Winter
en.description: A short visual novel about a boy and his senpai spending a night together in a snow-covered city.

floor2.name: MAHOUTEQ!
floor2.description: 失業中の少女ルナが大好きなフィギュアをどうしても欲しくて仕事探しせざるを得なくなるお話。

en.name: MAHOUTEQ!
en.description: A story about an unemployed girl named Luna, who wanted to buy her favorite figure so much that she had to get a job.

floor2.name: Shelldiver
floor2.description: 深呼吸して、この居心地の良いインクリメンタルゲームに飛び込んでみよう。ビジネスを始めようとする老齢のカメがクラゲを売る物語。装備をアップグレードし、バイオームを探索し、カメの村を助けよう！

en.name: Shelldiver
en.description: Take a deep breath and dive right into this cozy incremental game about a senior turtle trying to start a business selling jellyfish. Upgrade your equipment, explore biomes, and help your turtly village!

floor2.name: walk
floor2.description: it's about walking

en.name: walk
en.description: it's about walking

floor2.name: 虹の牛
floor2.description: 『あなたのレインボー・ニューニュー』は、デスクトップペットゲームです。10人の魅力的なキャラクターと1つの間抜けでかわいいレインボー・ニューニューと一緒に、こんな可愛いペットを飼ってみませんか？

en.name: Rainbow Cattle
en.description: Rainbow Cattle is a desktop pet game for computers. With 11 charming characters and one silly, adorable Rainbow Niu Niu, wouldn’t you want to raise such a cute pet?

floor2.name: OxU
floor2.description: Minimalistic 3d puzzle with portals, cubes and lasers.

en.name: OxU
en.description: Minimalistic 3d puzzle with portals, cubes and lasers.

floor2.name: Puzzline -パズライン-
floor2.description: パズルのようにカードを繋げて遊ぶ２～４人対戦ボードゲーム！ カードはそれぞれ特別な効果を持っているぞ！状況に合わせて戦略的にカードをプレイし、勝利を掴み取ろう！ オンライン対戦にも対応！

en.name: Puzzline
en.description: Puzzline is a 2-4 player board game connecting cards like a puzzle! Each card has a unique effect. Play them strategically and get the victory! Online play is also supported!

floor2.name: 中華・焼き冷麺・伝説
floor2.shortName: 中華・焼き冷麺・伝説
floor2.description: 夜市の暮らしと普通の人々の物語を描く経営シミュレーションゲーム。あなたは屋台の店主として、鉄板で焼冷麺を手際よく焼き上げる。夜の街を行き交う人々が足を止め、何気ない会話を交わす。仕事の愚痴、夢の話、ほんの少しの寂しさ、それらが煙と灯りに溶けていく。この小さな屋台で、あなたは料理をし、人に触れ、そして自分の人生を静かに生きていく。

en.name: Chinese Street Food Legend
en.description: A heartfelt game where you run a night market stall, cooking kaolengmian (grilled cold noodles). Customers come and go, stopping by to chat and share bits of their lives, joys, frustrations, and everyday struggles. At this little stall, you cook, listen, and keep living an ordinary person’s life.

floor2.name: フルーツマウンテン
floor2.description: フルーツを積み上げるパズルゲーム 同じ種類のフルーツをくっつけてどんどん大きくしよう！ お皿からあふれないように積み上げて、自分だけのフルーツマウンテンをつくろう！

en.name: Fruit Mountain
en.description: Fruit Stacking Puzzle Game Connect the same types of fruit together to make them grow bigger and bigger! Stack them up without letting them overflow from the plate, and build your own Fruit Mountain!

floor2.name: Mewseum: Masterpieces
floor2.description: Mewseum: Masterpieces は、シカク（shikaku）パズルスタイルのゲームです。グリッドを解くたびに名画の一部が明らかになります。数百ものパズルを解きながら、猫の世界の最新アート展でユニークな名画を発見しましょう！

en.name: Mewseum: Masterpieces
en.description: Mewseum: Masterpieces is a shikaku-style puzzle game where each solved grid reveals part of a great masterpiece. Solve hundreds of puzzles and discover unique paintings in the latest art exhibition of the feline world!

floor2.name: ポリリリリズム
floor2.description: SNS上で話題になったあのポリリリリズムが遂に正式版リリース！ 3拍子と5拍子と7拍子と…ややこしいポリリズムを乗りこなせるか！？ シンプルだけど難しい！新感覚リズムゲーム！

en.name: Polylylyrhythm
en.description: The much-talked-about "Polyrhythm" on social media has finally been officially released! Can you handle the 3/4, 5/4, 7/4... and all those crazy polyrhythms!? It’s simple yet incredibly challenging! A new kind of rhythm game is here! Come and test your rhythm skills in this beat-pounding madness!

floor2.name: Dogs Organized Neatly

floor2.name: Narcissu 10th Anniversary Anthology Project
floor2.description: 「人生はまるで待合室のようだねーーー人々が入ってきた順番と出て行く順番が異なることを除いては。」 ナルキッソスは不治の病、生きること、死ぬこと、そして去る者と残された者の関係を描いた感動的なビジュアルノベルシリーズ。この物語には奇跡も英雄も悪役も存在しない。冷酷で容赦のない厳正な現実の中ただ生きようと、自分たちなりの死への直面の仕方を探求するキャラクター達を描いた物語。

en.name: Narcissu 10th Anniversary Anthology Project
en.description: "Life is like a waiting room, except people don't leave in the order they enter." Narcissu is a thought provoking visual novel series about terminal illness, living, dying, and the relationship between those leaving and those left behind. There are no miracles, no heroes, no villains in this story. Just life and the characters finding their own ways of facing death in an indifferent, relentless, ever-impartial reality.

floor2.name: ゲーム燃え尽き症候群治療センター Gaming Burnout Treatment Center

en.name: Gaming Burnout Treatment Center

en.name: TOSS!🍌
en.description: IT'S TIME TO GO BANANAS! Swing & toss yourself freely across spacey jungle-gym playgrounds as an acrobatic monkey, in this bananas VR platformer. Your agility, timing and VR gamer skill are about to go on a truly bananas ride!

floor2.name: Climb Up Together
genres: 精密プラットフォーム
floor2.description: 1～4人で遊べる協力型クライミングゲーム。交通事故で命を落としたあなたたちは、生者の世界へと続く塔のふもとで骸骨として地獄で目を覚ます。さまざまなパルクールコースを越え、登りながら体のパーツを集め、頂上で再び人間に戻ろう。

en.name: Climb Up Together
en.description: A 1-4 player co-op climbing game. Killed in a traffic accident, you wake up in hell as skeletons at the foot of a tower that reaches the living world. Climb past various parkour courses, collect your body parts on the way up and become human again by the summit.

floor2.name: My Home/Zombie Center
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
floor2.description: いろいろな商品が並ぶホームセンターを舞台に、そこで拾える道具類を武器にしてひたすらゾンビを倒していく三人称視点のアクションゲームです。 登場する武器はそれぞれ特有の使い勝手を持っており、自分に合った武器を見つけたり、それぞれに適した戦い方を見つける楽しみが有ります。

en.name: My Home/Zombie Center
en.description: This is a third-person action game set in a home improvement center. You can use the tools as weapons to defeat zombies. Each weapon in the game has its own unique usability, so players can have fun finding the right weapon for themselves and finding the right fighting style for each weapon.

floor2.name: BZZZT: バズボット！
genres: 精密プラットフォーム
floor2.description: 小さなロボット「ZX8000」を操作し、数々のプラットフォーム系ゲームの名作にインスパイアされた、美しいドット絵の世界へ旅立とう。お茶目なストーリーを進めてスキルを磨き、激ムズステージのクリアタイムをほかのプレイヤーと競え!

en.name: BZZZT
en.description: Become a tiny ZX8000 robot and begin your journey through a beautiful, pixel-art world inspired by games iconic to the platformer genre. Follow a cute story, upgrade your skills, beat challenging levels, and compete with other players for the fastest speedrun!

floor2.name: ふしぎの城のヘレン+
floor2.description: ～少しだけ考えるRPG～ 美しいドット絵とタイムカウント性のバトルが魅力のRPG。4～5時間ほどでクリアできるボリュームながら、その完成度は極めて高い短編RPG。

en.name: Helen's Mysterious Castle
en.description: A young girl with a hidden past sets off on an epic and mysterious journey in hope of learning more about her own origins in this beautifully rendered, classic-style RPG adventure.

floor2.name: Human-powered spacecraft
floor2.description: ユーモアあふれるノスタルジックなピクセルクリッカー

en.name: Human-powered spacecraft
en.description: A nostalgia-infused pixel clicker in a comedy wrapper.

floor2.name: トルービズの秘薬師
floor2.description: 言語解読ゲームはなんぼあってもいいですよね。薬師として、架空の言語で書かれたマニュアルを読み解き、ポーションを調合して患者に処方していく短編パズルゲームです。“読めるようになる”快感と、治療の結果で変化する小さなドラマが楽しめる、手軽な言語解読体験を提供します。

en.name: The Apothecary of Trubiz
en.description: A short puzzle game where you decipher a fictional language, mix potions, and treat patients. Enjoy the thrill of understanding and the small stories that unfold from each cure.

floor2.name: SiNKR / シズめル
floor2.description: SiNKRはさまざまなからくりを使って円盤を穴に入れるミニマリストパズルゲームです。BGMがプレイに反応します。

en.name: SiNKR
en.description: SiNKR is a minimalist puzzler using various contraptions to sink pucks. Responsive ambient music. No holes left behind.

floor2.name: Up Left Out
floor2.description: パズルのロックを解除する

en.name: Up Left Out
en.description: A puzzle game about unlocking stuff.

floor2.name: Merge Maestro
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
floor2.description: 300種類+のemojiトークンを使うローグライクゲームトークンとパワーからユニークなコンボや戦術を見つけ出す、パズルのような楽しさのある一風変わったアーケード風ローグライク！

en.name: Merge Maestro
en.description: Combine 100's of unique emoji based tokens in this roguelike merge-builder! Find ever more creative combinations of Tokens and Powers to fuse unique strategies and beat this ever more challenging twist on rogue-likes, puzzlers and arcadey games!

floor2.name: Toilet 8
floor2.description: え、Toilet 8 🚽💩を知らない？世界一くだらないパロディ系異変ゲーム。公衆トイレのループに閉じ込められ、毎回どこがおかしいかを見抜く。バカバカしい驚きと下品なトイレ系ユーモア満載。

en.name: Toilet 8
en.description: What, you don’t know Toilet 8 🚽💩? The most immature parody anomaly game ever made? You’re stuck in a loop of public toilets where you must spot what’s wrong each time. Absurd surprises and plenty of poop-fart humor designed to make you laugh.

floor2.name: Chill Pulse
floor2.description: Chill Pulseは、生産性ツールと穏やかな環境を組み合わせています。ポモドーロタイマーやToDoリストを使用して集中力を高め、サイバーパンクの都市から古代の風景まで、環境音がリラックス感を高めます。

trailers.name: chill pulse trailer new space scene - english

en.name: Chill Pulse
en.description: Chill Pulse combines productivity tools with serene environments. Use a Pomodoro timer and to-do lists to boost focus, while ambient sounds in settings from cyberpunk cities to ancient landscapes enhance relaxation.

floor2.name: Maskmaker
floor2.description: In an all new mysterious universe built by the developers of the award-winning A Fisherman's Tale, you play as a Maskmaker's apprentice and learn the magic of crafting masks to immerse yourself in the intriguing enigmatic beings within the game.

en.name: Maskmaker
en.description: In an all new mysterious universe built by the developers of the award-winning A Fisherman's Tale, you play as a Maskmaker's apprentice and learn the magic of crafting masks to immerse yourself in the intriguing enigmatic beings within the game.

floor2.name: Sudoku Jigsaw / 拼图数独
floor2.description: Love Sudoku, but tired of default one? Try this.

en.name: Sudoku Jigsaw / 拼图数独
en.description: Love Sudoku, but tired of default one? Try this.

floor2.name: 心霊物件
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 格安アパートで始まる新生活。 夜中の奇妙な現象と隣人の不審な行動が主人公を追い詰めていく。

en.name: Haunted Property
en.description: A new life begins in a low-cost apartment. Strange occurrences at night and the suspicious behavior of neighbors gradually push the protagonist to the edge.

floor2.name: 闇鍋人狼
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
floor2.description: 闇鍋人狼は皆で鍋を作る正体隠匿ゲームです。仲間同士で相談してダンジョンで食材を集め、おいしい鍋を作ります。ただし、中には裏切り者が紛れていて鍋を作るのを邪魔してくるかも……。お互いの正体を隠しながら理想の鍋を作ろう！

en.name: Hodgepodge Hunch
en.description: Hodgepodge Hunch is a who-done-it game where everyone chips in to make a hotpot dish. Collaborate with your buddies to collect ingredients in the dungeons and whip up a delicious feast. There's just one problem... A backstabber may be lurking among you who'll throw your dinner plans awry...

floor2.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
floor2.description: Placid Plastic Duckがマルチプレイに？ レースにミニゲーム、さらに最大50人で集まれるプールまで？ そのとおり！ 友達とまったり過ごして、プールでいちばん気品あふれるアヒルになろう！

en.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
en.description: Placid Plastic Duck in multiplayer? With races, minigames, and a shared pool for up to 50 players? Yes! Chill with friends and become the pool’s most distinguished duck!

floor2.name: まぼろしキャラバン
floor2.description: まぼろしキャラバンは小さく抽象的なドット絵で表現された、沙漠を旅するキャラバンを観測し、時々助ける見守り型シミュレーションゲームです。多くの仲間と共に、多様な表情を持つ広大な沙漠の旅に出かけましょう。 マウス・キーボード操作です。

en.name: maboroshi caravan
en.description: maboroshi caravan is a simulation game about a journey through the desert. Many are represented by small, abstract pixel arts. Set out on a journey through a vast desert with diverse expressions with companions. The game is played with mouse and keyboard.

floor2.name: Sandwich +1
floor2.description: あなたのサンドイッチはもう手に負えません。フードタワーを積み上げ、顔のついたドリンクたちに売って、そのうち空飛ぶスタッフを雇えば、クリックまで代わりにやってくれます。一晩だけ、でもちゃんと終わります。

en.name: Sandwich +1
en.description: Your sandwiches are getting out of hand. Stack food towers, sell them off to drinks with faces, and eventually hire flying workers until they're doing all the clicking. One evening, and a real ending.

floor2.name: The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix
floor2.shortName: THE LEGEND OF TIGER AND PHOENIX
floor2.description: The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenixはエネルギーブラストと空中浮遊、そして透明人間の人生を経験することができるこれまでにないユニークなパリィ​/潜入ゲームです。

trailers.name: The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix Teaser
The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix Teaser 2
The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix Gameplay Trailer

en.name: The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix
en.description: The Legend of Tiger And Phoenix is a unique timing-parrying/infiltrating game that allows you to experience Fireballs, Energy Blast, ​levitating, and the life of an invisible man.

floor2.name: Age of Borders: WW3
floor2.description: 世界が第三次世界大戦の瀬戸際へと向かう中、現実世界のマップ上で200以上の国からひとつを選び、指揮を執ろう。世界各地の9つの火種がエスカレートしていくなか、産業、外交、軍をリアルタイムで動かせ。結末が平和か、超大国同士の戦争か、核による破滅かは、あなたの選択で決まる。

en.name: Age of Borders: WW3
en.description: Take command of any of over 200 nations on a real-world map as the world edges toward World War III. Manage industry, diplomacy and armies in real time while nine global flashpoints escalate. Your choices determine whether it ends in peace, a superpower war or nuclear ruin.

floor2.name: Wheel Make It
floor2.description: 1台の車椅子。2人のプレイヤー。無限大のカオス。チームワーク、ドタバタ、無敵の友情パワーを描くソロおよび協力プレイ対応の物理演算ゲーム。

en.name: Wheel Make It
en.description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

floor2.name: Wizard Jars: Tidy Up Together
floor2.description: 『Wizard Jars』は、ひとりでもオンライン協力プレイでも楽しめる、のんびりした整理整頓ゲーム。散らかった魔法薬店で3,240個の魔法の瓶を棚に戻し、お客さんの依頼をこなし、アップグレードを解放して、お店に秩序を取り戻そう。

en.name: Wizard Jars: Tidy Up Together
en.description: Wizard Jars is a cozy solo and co-op sorting game where you organize 3,240 magical jars in a chaotic apothecary. Put every jar back on its shelf, fulfill magical customer requests, unlock useful upgrades, and restore the apothecary to perfect order

floor2.name: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds
floor2.shortName: CLOUDGAZER: A GAME ABOUT WATCHING CLOUDS
floor2.description: 雲を眺めることを楽しむゲーム。何百もの隠れた形を見つけ、パレイドリアを鍛えて、あとは想像力に身を任せましょう。

trailers.name: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds - Teaser
Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds - Trailer

en.name: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds
en.description: A game about watching clouds. Discover hundreds of hidden shapes, train your pareidolia, and let your imagination do the rest.

floor2.name: Loot Loop
floor2.description: ヒーローのパーティを編成し、ダンジョンへ派遣する手軽な放置系RPG。モンスターを倒し、戦利品を集め、アップグレードをアンロック。サクサク進む冒険、奥深いスキルツリー、そしてストレスゼロ。

en.name: Loot Loop
en.description: Build a party of heroes and send them into dungeons in this short incremental RPG. Fight monsters, collect loot, and unlock upgrades. Fast runs, deep skill tree, zero stress.

floor2.name: Jet Lancer
floor2.description: Jet Lancer は遠い未来の大胆不敵な兵士となり、激しいドッグファイトを繰り広げ、敵パイロットを追い詰め、巨大ロボットを粉々にし、死の恐怖をものともせずせず超音速で飛び回ります。

en.name: Jet Lancer
en.description: Jet Lancer is a high-velocity aerial combat shooter where you duel enemy aviators, hunt giant robots, and defy death at supersonic speeds as you evolve from an unknown rookie aviator into a once-in-a-generation ACE pilot.

floor2.name: LineWay
floor2.description: あなたは線を引いてもいいですか?

en.name: LineWay
en.description: Can you draw a line?

floor2.name: NABOKI
floor2.description: パズルを分解します。

en.name: NABOKI
en.description: Relaxing disassemble puzzle.

floor2.description: A short story about what sort of challenges everyday little things can be. Help the girl buy milk, be the first not to disappoint her.

en.name: Milk inside a bag of milk inside a bag of milk
en.description: A short story about what sort of challenges everyday little things can be. Help the girl buy milk, be the first not to disappoint her.

floor2.name: Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands
floor2.description: Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands lets you explore freely and at your pace entire ski resorts and the surrounding mountains. Unlock ski lifts and reach new areas by competing in challenges, or enjoy the scenery while you find your own path down the mountains.

en.name: Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands
en.description: Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands lets you explore freely and at your pace entire ski resorts and the surrounding mountains. Unlock ski lifts and reach new areas by competing in challenges, or enjoy the scenery while you find your own path down the mountains.

floor2.name: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ参
floor2.shortName: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ参
floor2.description: 江戸時代を舞台にした、オンライン協力プレイ型のコインプッシャーゲーム「古銭プッシャーフレンズ」のシリーズ3作目です。今作では、東海道五十三次をテーマにしたすごろくがあり、止まったマスによって様々なイベントが発生します。他のプレイヤーと協力して妖怪を退治したり、悪代官を成敗したり、ジャックポットを目指したりしましょう。ゲームを進めると様々な方法で能力アップできます。

en.name: Old Coin Pusher Friends 3
en.description: In this installment, there is a Sugoroku themed around the old Japan, with various events triggered by the squares you land on. Work together with other players to defeat yokai, and aim for the jackpot. As you progress in the game, you can enhance your abilities with various upgrades.

floor2.name: FIND ALL: Bunker
floor2.description: 核爆弾の脅威が迫ってきた。危機に備えて、地上から地下のバンカーを探索する旅に出よう。いろいろなアイテムを見つけて、白黒の世界をカラフルに彩ろう。

en.name: FIND ALL: Bunker
en.description: Explore the underground bunker and the surface of the earth in anticipation of a nuclear explosion, finding various items and painting the black and white picture with colored inks.

floor2.name: 魔女ボーグ メグリロ
floor2.shortName: 魔女ボーグ メグリロ
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
floor2.description: 時間を止め、空間を跳び越す魔法「トキトメワープ」で弾幕や地形をくぐり抜けて敵を撃て！爽快なゲーム性と、シニカルな笑いに満ちたダーク・コメディシューティング！

en.name: WITCH-BOT MEGLILO
en.description: Stop time and project yourself through space with “Time-stop warp” magic, pass through physical obstacles, dodge incoming bullets and shoot down your enemies! A satisfying shooter, filled with dark humor!

floor2.name: 光るだけしかない機械
floor2.shortName: 光るだけしかない機械
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
floor2.description: 光るだけしかない60分のアドベンチャー

en.name: Glow Box
en.description: A 60-minute adventure where all you do is glow.

floor2.name: MECHBLAZE
floor2.description: 崩壊する秘密基地。鋼の群れを切り裂くマシンガン。必殺の鉄杭打突兵器…そして、瓦礫の中から蘇る無敵のスーパーロボ！近代兵器とスーパーメカが入り乱れる超重量級“ブンドド”横スクロールアクション！！

en.name: MECHBLAZE
en.description: An inferno roars over a destroyed secret military base. Then, from the flaming rubble...an invincible super robot is reborn! Mechs born of advanced science and modern weaponry battle in heavy weight Run 'n Gun mech shooter!!

floor2.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6
floor2.description: かわいい猫娘たちと一緒に、回転パズルを解こう。のんびり楽しめる、ゆるやかな成長要素のあるゲームプレイ。猫娘とおしゃべり。なぜかパズルが上達していく。ちょっと怪しい選択をする。意外と役に立つアイテムをアンロック。

en.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6
en.description: Solve rotating puzzles with cute cat girls. Cozy, soft-incremental gameplay. Chat With Cat Girls. Somehow Get Better at Puzzles. Make Questionable Choices. Unlock Surprisingly Useful Stuff.

floor2.name: 📷🔍 Pictective
floor2.description: 画像を見つけたり、キャプチャを解くのが得意だと思う？ ドマという好奇心旺盛な子猫と一緒に、探偵になるためのトレーニングを始めたばかりの冒険に参加しよう！ ドマが画像マッチングの挑戦をクリアするのを手伝って、スキルを披露してね！

en.name: 📷🔍 Pictective
en.description: Think you're good at spotting images and solving captchas? Join Doma, a curious little cat who's just started training to become a detective! Help Doma take on picture-matching challenges to prove your skills!

floor2.name: タネ屋さんを整理しよう！
floor2.shortName: タネ屋さんを整理しよう！
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 床やカウンターに散らばった何千もの種袋、球根商品、鉢植え、苗木を仕分けて、レトロなタネ屋さんを元の姿に戻そう。ラベルを読み、商品をまとめて運び、300種類以上の商品を定位置に戻しながら、作業を効率化する能力をアンロック。棚を一段ずつ埋めて、お店に秩序を取り戻そう。

en.name: Seed Shop: Tidy Up!
en.description: Restore a vintage seed shop by sorting thousands of scattered seed packets, bulbs, potted plants, and saplings. Read the labels, carry stacks, fill more than 300 plant slots, and unlock faster ways to bring order back one shelf at a time.

floor2.name: Shore Doodle –渚のお絵描き–
genres: デザイン＆イラストレーション
floor2.description: 起動すれば夏の砂浜はあなたのもの。砂浜を自由に歩き回り、木の枝で絵を描きましょう。描いた線が波に飲み込まれて消えるまでの短い時間で、どんな絵を描けるでしょうか。お絵描きしている間にも時間は流れて空の様子は変化します。たまに空を見上げると、そこに癒しや発見があるかもしれません。

en.name: Shore Doodle
en.description: Let's enjoy your own personal beach. Wander around at your leisure and use a branch to draw in the sand. What will you draw in the short time you have before the sea washes it away? The time-of-day changes as you draw, bringing you relaxation, and perhaps new discoveries...

floor2.name: ８番出口
floor2.description: あなたは無限に続く地下通路に閉じ込められている。 周囲をよく観察し、「８番出口」まで辿り着こう。

en.name: The Exit 8
en.description: You are trapped in an endless underground passageway. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach "The Exit 8".

floor2.name: qop

en.name: qop

floor2.name: 1bitHeart
floor2.description: 本作は、『Alicemare』『LiEat』を開発された△○□×（みわしいば）氏による、友達を作りつつ、ついでに街の事件も解決していくアドベンチャーゲームです。

en.name: 1bitHeart
en.description: Welcome to 1bitHeart―the latest title from Alicemare and LiEat developer △○□× (Miwashiba). In this unique and endearing adventure game, take on the role of Nanashi, a lonely, agoraphobic boy, as you solve a slew of mysteries around town while also making friends.

floor2.name: Art Of Gravity
floor2.description: Art Of Gravity は、抽象的な図形を破壊するというテーマを中心に展開するボクセル/物理学ベースのパズルゲームであり、結果的に魅力的な重力のダンスが表示されます。

en.name: Art Of Gravity
en.description: Art Of Gravity is a voxel/physics based puzzle game, revolving around the theme of destroying abstract figures, which results in mesmerizing displays of dance of gravity.

floor2.name: 絶対遵守
floor2.description: 🌐 言語不要 【規則は絶対。破れば即、＂死＂】無人の雑居ビルからの脱出を目指す、一人称視点の短編脱出デスゲーム。ランダムに変化する規則を絶対に守り抜き、ギミックを突破して脱出せよ。

en.name: No exceptions

Break a rule and it’s game over. Don’t run. Don’t stop. Don’t look. Learn the rules. Obey them. Escape alive.

floor2.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model

floor2.name: Teddy Horses

en.name: Teddy Horses

floor2.name: Fill Up The Hole

en.name: Fill Up The Hole

floor2.name: Villages & Dungeons

An interactive story about a boy who spends his summers wandering between past and present... After meeting her, summer will never be the same again...Who is she, and what journey awaits you?

floor2.name: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ２

floor2.name: CounterAttack: Uprising

en.name: Re:Fresh
en.description: Restore your town as you run, jump and dash through cozy locales while helping lovable townsfolk! Become immersed in a tight-knit community of animals and robots while becoming the town hero in this heart-warming solarpunk adventure.

floor2.name: Hellsinker.

en.name: Hellsinker.

floor2.name: NAGAISAN
floor2.description: 私は『彼女』を知ってしまった。それ以来、どこからか誰かの視線を感じている。昔、迷子になった犬を探して辿り着いた場所の記憶。それが関係しているのかはわからないが。私は何かをしてしまった。『ナガイサン』はどこからでも入ってくる、たとえ夢の中でも。『NAGAISAN』は都市伝説を題材としたアドベンチャーゲームです。

en.name: NAGAISAN
en.description: I came to know "her." Since then, I've felt someone's gaze from somewhere. Memories of the place I reached while searching for a lost dog in the past. I'm not sure if it's connected, but I did something. "NAGAISAN" is an adventure game based on urban legends.

floor2.name: 東方文殿生存 ~Library Survivors~

This isn't even your house, and the current residents don't appreciate having their food slapped around.

en.name: Beyond the Wall

floor2.name: サカバンバスピスクロニクル

en.name: Sacabambaspis Chronicle
en.description: As a player, you become Sacabambaspis and live each day with your fellow Sacabambaspis, growing and evolving by swimming in the sea and eating plankton. Progress through the story with your companions in Sacabambaspis, and see what happens in the end.

floor2.name: Foreskin Fury
floor2.description: 友達と対戦するか、間抜けなボットと激闘を繰り広げろ！ユニークな能力を使いこなし、笑えるアクセサリーで自分をカスタマイズし、アリーナを制覇するんだ。今までにないペニス大乱闘の荒々しい冒険に備えろ！

en.name: Foreskin Fury

Harness unique abilities, customize your member with an array of hilarious accessories, and dominate the arena. Get ready for a wild ride of phallic mayhem unlike anything you've experienced before!

floor2.name: ゾンビスープ
floor2.description: 「ゾンビスープ（Zombie Soup）」は、大学1年生の青年リッキーが、ゾンビやモンスターが蔓延る街で、誘拐された少女を救うために銃を撃ちながら予想外の冒険を繰り広げるトップダウン形式のアクションシューティングゲームです！

en.name: Zombie Soup
en.description: Zombie Soup is a top-down shooter combined with hack and slash action that follows Ricky, a backpacker who is thrown into an unexpected adventure in an unfamiliar town as he shoots and dodges his way through hordes of bizarre creatures and challenging bosses to save a kidnapped girl!

floor2.name: TAKIBI
floor2.description: 日常の忙しさや冷たさを忘れ、時に炎を見つめ、そして自分を見つめる。 そんな時間があってもいいのではないでしょうか。

en.name: TAKIBI

floor2.name: Alicemare

en.name: Tchia
en.description: A Tropical Open-World adventure. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around a beautiful archipelago in this physics-driven sandbox. Take control of any animal or object you can find, and Jam on your fully playable Ukulele.

floor2.name: Slimeward

en.name: Sudoku Killer / 杀手数独
en.description: Killer Sudoku (Sumdoku/Mathdoku/Addoku) puzzles include all the rules of regular Sudoku, but add in dashed-line 'cages', which must sum to given values. This great brain exerciser will provide you many hours of new Sudoku experience and be nice addition to your puzzle collection.

floor2.description: 宇宙のスリル満点の冒険に備えましょう！Space Elite Forceは、武器のカスタマイズと壮大なボスバトルが詰まった熱狂的な宇宙シューティングゲームです。あなたの船を指揮し、人類の生存のために戦いましょう！

en.name: Space Elite Force
en.description: Gear up for an intergalactic thrill ride! Space Elite Force is a frenzied space-shooter packed with weapon customization and epic boss battles. Take command of your ship and fight for the survival of humanity!

floor2.name: No.9
floor2.description: Synchronizing form and time.

en.name: No.9
en.description: Synchronizing form and time.

floor2.name: The Deal
floor2.description: The Deal unravels the story of Cyrus, Myrella, Jonathan and Donna, while they traverse through the colorful continent of Carca, in a 10+ hours enthralling adventure!

en.name: The Deal
en.description: The Deal unravels the story of Cyrus, Myrella, Jonathan and Donna, while they traverse through the colorful continent of Carca, in a 10+ hours enthralling adventure!

floor2.name: ROCKETRON
floor2.description: 飛びまわれ！ 撃ちまくれ！ ロケット銃のブースト飛行で敵の攻撃やトラップを華麗にかわし、大要塞を高速探索。手軽な探索と骨太な戦闘が楽しめる、飛翔型アクションシューティング。

en.name: ROCKETRON
en.description: Fly through the sky! Rain down fire on the enemy forces from above! Enjoy solid combat and simple non-linear exploration in this high flying side-scrolling action shooter!

floor2.name: Getsuei Gakuen -kou-
floor2.description: 豪華スタッフと豪華声優陣が多数携わっており、様々な創作活動を行いマルチに活躍中の声優『杉田智和』氏が原作の『学園伝奇アドベンチャー』！

en.name: Getsuei Gakuen -kou-
en.description: Miracle collaboration work by Tomokazu Sugita, multi-talent voice-cast, and Toshimichi Mori, BLAZBLUE series producer! Please note that this game is only available in Japanese.

floor2.name: 20 Floors
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
floor2.description: You are left alone on the top floor of an apartment. Your only goal is to reach the ground. But as you descend, the corridor you once knew begins to warp into something grotesque. There’s no telling what horror awaits. Just don't stop. Keep going down.

en.name: 20 Floors
en.description: You are left alone on the top floor of an apartment. Your only goal is to reach the ground. But as you descend, the corridor you once knew begins to warp into something grotesque. There’s no telling what horror awaits. Just don't stop. Keep going down.

en.name: Deadlock
en.description: Deadlock is a multiplayer game in early development.

en.name: Dear Passengers
en.description: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

en.name: Light No Fire
en.description: A game about adventure, building, survival and exploration together. Set on a fantasy planet the size of Earth.

en.name: Fable
en.description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

en.name: Blight: Survival
en.description: Blight: Survival is a PvE Action-Horror Game set in a brutal medieval world. Play in solo or team-up with up to 3 friends as you face monsters and men in a tense battle for survival. How far are you willing to go?

en.name: Resident Evil Veronica
en.description: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

en.name: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000
en.description: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

en.name: Kingmakers
en.description: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.

en.name: Witchbrook
en.description: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

en.name: ILL
en.description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

en.name: Soulframe
en.description: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.

en.name: ARK 2
en.description: Survive the past. Tame the future. Suddenly awakened on a primal world filled with dinosaurs and humans struggling for dominance, you must team-up with legendary heroes to confront powerful dark forces. Saddle up, and join the definitive next-gen survival experience with ARK 2!

en.name: METRO 2039
en.description: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

en.name: Unrecord
en.description: Unrecord is a single-player FPS that tells the story of a tactical police officer from the perspective of his body camera. As you work to solve a complex case, you'll need to use your tactical and detective skills to succeed.

en.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
en.description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

en.name: Persona 4 Revival
en.description: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

en.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
en.description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

en.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
en.description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

en.name: Tides of Annihilation
en.description: Tides of Annihilation is an action-adventure game steeped in the legends of King Arthur. When an otherworldly invasion shatters London, Gwendolyn, a lone survivor, embarks on a desperate quest to fight back and uncover the truth that lies beyond the veil.

en.name: Chrono Odyssey
en.description: Chrono Odyssey, A Next-generation Action MMORPG. Game features include awe-inspiring visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, a vast and intricately designed seamless open world, dynamic action-based combat mechanics based on time manipulation and extensive customization.

en.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
en.description: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

en.name: State of Decay 3
en.description: Play as a community of survivors, build up your settlements with friends, and destroy zombies in State of Decay 3, the latest in the franchise from developer Undead Labs.

en.name: Vindictus: Defying Fate
en.description: Experience intense action brought to life with diverse, unique characters. Read your enemy’s attacks and strike back for maximum impact in Vindictus: Defying Fate. Immerse yourself in signature combat and a gripping narrative.

en.name: NAKWON: LAST PARADISE
en.description: NAKWON is a multiplayer zombie survival game set in urban South Korea. Venture into the city in the dead of night, and manage your shelter by day. Scavenge resources in a city crawling with the infected and hostile survivors. Survival is the only rule - trust no one, not even the living.

en.name: Chronicles: Medieval
en.description: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

en.name: Railborn
en.description: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

en.name: Rooted
en.description: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

en.name: Alkahest
en.description: Alkahest is an Action-Adventure RPG set in a murky medieval world. Where satisfying melee combat with highly interactive environments takes center stage. Explore realistic locations, learn alchemy and make a name for your family.

en.name: Persona 6
en.description: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.

upcoming.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State

en.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State
en.description: A horror-infused extraction shooter for squads of three. Crush monster hordes with devastating firepower in co-op PvE, or take on rival squads for The Vertex in PvP. Choose your battle, push as far as you dare, and make it out alive.

en.name: Emberville
en.description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

en.name: Showa American Story
en.description: Showa American Story is an RPG steeped in retro pop culture. In the late 1980s, a dominant Japan culturally colonized America. Resurrected from the grave, Chigusa Choko embarks on a road trip of combat, exploration, and growth across a world both absurd and strangely familiar.

en.name: Falling Frontier
en.description: Conquer a vast procedurally generated star system in Falling Frontier, a sci-fi RTS where intel and logistics are decisive factors. Design ships and raid enemy supply lines, lay minefields and construct recon stations, and ambush enemy forces within asteroid fields and nebulae.

en.name: Ardem
en.description: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.

en.name: Guild Wars 3™
en.description: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder.

en.name: Haunted Paws
en.description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

en.name: Beautiful Light
en.description: Beautiful Light, a PvPvPvE tactical first-person extraction shooter where 6 squads of 3 operators are tasked with entering, securing, and extracting an artifact in a hostile, horrific environment. Face other operators and player-controlled anomalies, but beware: mistakes can risk your life and gear.

en.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
en.description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

en.name: NO LAW
en.description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

en.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
en.description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

en.name: The Hollowing
en.description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

en.name: Book of Aliens
en.description: Aliens invade Paperverse! Protect the terrorized civilians and discover the source of the alien threat in this minimalist game of battlefield tactics and global defense strategy.

en.name: Speak
en.description: Speak is a 2–8 player game of diplomacy, deception, and betrayal, where voice chat becomes your weapon. Use your phone to have private conversations, forge secret alliances, and plot against the other players.

en.name: Carbon
en.description: Carbon is Action RPG set in cyberpunk/biopunk world. Create your path to power through 18 uniquely themed specializations in the passive skill tree. Carbon is developed by a team of industry veterans and ARPG enthusiasts who have long felt that the sci-fi theme was underrepresented in this genre.

en.name: SECOND-LOOP™
en.description: Half-Like with Mech。In the SECOND-LOOP™, you're a hero mech pilot in the heart of a futuristic dystopian world. Use your enhanced gravity manipulation power to assemble objects.

en.name: Supermarket
en.description: Run your own supermarket in this chaotic co-op/singleplayer simulator! Stock shelves, manage customers, and overcome quirky challenges in a lively, customizable store. Work solo or team up with friends for hilarious, fast-paced fun.

en.name: KING's RAID RE:VERSE
en.description: Experience real-time strategic battles in the RPG 'KING's RAID RE:VERSE' Combine hero skills and explore an immersive world unique to KING's RAID RE:VERSE. Join countless heroes on an endless adventure full of action and strategy.

en.name: Moonlight Pale
en.description: Juliette follows the ghost of her dead cat into a nightmare where she has to fight and solve puzzles through eerily familiar corridors as she tries to survive and help the rest of the girls trapped inside. Discover the sins buried under St. Birgitta's Female Seminary.

en.name: We Stay Behind
en.description: We Stay Behind is a single-player third-person mystery between dreams and reality. A comet is on course to destroy a small town but its inhabitants refuse to leave. Interview the people of Laburnum Creek, explore a beautiful national park and unravel the secrets of this picturesque town.

upcoming.name: Chill with You : SHIOI's Sparkling Scenes

en.name: Chill with You : SHIOI's Sparkling Scenes
en.description: This is a Lo-Fi Productivity Visual Novel Game where you work alongside the expressive girl Shioi to stay focused. Use productivity tools and mix Lo-Fi music with ambient sounds to create your ideal workspace. Keep working together, and perhaps one day you and Shioi will grow closer…?

en.name: Delta
en.description: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

en.name: BLIGHTEN
en.description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

en.name: Love Nest
en.description: 《爱之巢》是一场关于血肉、爱与救赎、恨与纠缠的冒险。密室逃脱也好、视觉小说也好、电子宠物也好……这些都只是这场冒险的冰山一角。唯一重要的只有……属于你的少女——『晴』，永远在你们的《爱之巢》，微笑着等着你。

en.name: Totally Safe Railway Co. 🚂
en.description: Run a railroad company with your friends in the Wild West! Operate a physics-driven steam train. Transport goods and passengers, fight off outlaws, explore the frontier and use your lasso on practically anything.

en.name: Ghost Vanguard
en.description: Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements. Grab your sword and step into treacherous evil dungeons, using stylish and magnificent combos to defeat the sinister forces from the darkness and reclaim a hero's stolen soul.

en.name: Route 66 Simulator
en.description: Have you ever dreamed about leaving everything behind and setting out on an great road trip across the United States? Get a budget, build your car and make your dream come true! Try to survive on the most famous road in the world!

en.name: Code of The Savage
en.description: Thrown overboard from a slave ship, you wash ashore in chains in a brutal, handcrafted kingdom. Code of The Savage is a dark fantasy open-world RPG inspired by the classics, where exploration, survival, NPC interaction, and the consequences of your choices shape your path.

en.name: Deliver Us Home
en.description: Deliver Us Home is a solitary sci-fi experience where one astronaut works to secure a home and new future for humanity.

en.name: Fallen Fates
en.description: Venture into a vast 2D pixel-art fantasy world, face relentless battles and forge your destiny with vivid companions as you unravel the truth behind the falling crystals.

en.name: Metal Revolution / 金属对决
en.description: Metal Revolution is a new generation of fighting game. The minimalistic controls, deep gameplay, and the cyberpunk robot theme are designed to bring a fresh battle experience. For the fighters who never flinch in the face of furious combat, welcome to Metal Revolution.

en.name: We are Legion: Rome
en.description: In We are Legion: Rome you play the role of Cassius a Roman legionnaire plagued by nightmares of war. Take part in this action-adventure game and fight in brutal battles to experience the impact war may have on a soldier.

en.name: Red Kiss
en.description: Dispatch a team of vampire spies through the tense and fractured streets of Cold War Berlin. Fulfill your darkest impulses as you tap into their powers, gain their trust, and manipulate your way through this (blood)thirsty Tactical Narrative RPG.

en.name: Armaphract
en.description: Outmatched, outgunned, but not outsmarted, you'll command a tank squad in tense urban warfare across a shattered megacity. A great power has collapsed, and opportunity is in the air. Take contracts and ambush powerful enemies, customize your squad, and reap the rewards.

en.name: Magnavale: Eternal Soul
en.description: Eternal Soul is a gothic Metroidvania where you steal the souls of your enemies. Explore the castle, find powerful items & abilities, fight against demonic creatures, and learn the truth of your power.

upcoming.name: Touhou Dungeon Maker: The labyrinth of heart

en.name: Touhou Dungeon Maker: The labyrinth of heart
en.description: Touhou Dungeon Maker is a roguelike x tower defense style dungeon management RPG. Strengthen characters, place multiple traps and facilities, and keep fighting off massive numbers of incoming phantoms. It's time to unravel the mysteries of the magical dungeon!

en.name: Cook, Serve, Delicious: Remustard!
en.description: Welcome back, Chef! Take your restaurant from a one star abomination to a five star wonder in this new take on a million-selling classic. With new art, a new campaign, and a new local co-op mode, there's never been a better time to get cooking.

upcoming.name: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant

en.name: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant
en.description: Trade, traverse, and earn coins in this strategy merchant game set in a handcrafted world shaped by secrets and volatile markets. Join Viia, the fox merchant, as she defies the mighty Basilisk Company in the hunt for the truth behind the Golden Merchant.

en.name: Wisplight
en.description: Be the monster and defend your land against human invaders and settlers. Amass your forces, fortify your base, raid human enemy settlements, unlock multiple transformations, and engage in a compelling story with multiple endings. All these, and more, in Wisplight!

en.name: DEFICIT
en.description: You are a corporate espionage freelancer. Your latest assignment: steal the reality-shifting Interpolator from the sprawling research labs of Project Sidereal. Use the device to escape the grueling defensive layers of Hadrian's Wall and cross the threshold into the strangest frontiers of reality.

en.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
en.description: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.

en.name: Vikings On Trampolines
en.description: It's all about trampolines! Stay on the trampolines and push your opponents off to win. Brawl against your friends or work together to save the kingdom. Big bosses, big minigames and evil balloons..? Play solo or local multiplayer for up to 4 players! Accessible controls: Only one hand needed.

en.name: Earthbreakers
en.description: Satellites rain death as factions fight for control of a Broken Earth. Protect your team's harvesters, build factories and vehicles, and assault the enemy base. It's team FPS action in an RTS world!

en.name: Prism 2033
en.description: Prism 2033 is a next-generation Futuristic Parallel-Universe MMORPG built with Unreal Engine 5. Travel across parallel worlds, take on new challenges, and shape the future of the Parallverse.

en.name: Times of Survival
en.description: Times of Survival is a co-op zombie survival game with souls-like inspired combat system, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Fortify your base, fight hordes of zombies and battle epic bosses. Explore, craft, and master punishing combat while building your settlement and leading survivors to hope.

en.name: Windwoven
en.description: You inherit forest edge land. Daily, till soil with your hoe grow radishes, rear chicks, bond with oddball neighbors. Spring seeds yield summer gardens; autumn's firelit pumpkins reveal woodland mysteries. Nighttime under trees, fireflies dance like starlit constellations, this is your idyllic life.

en.name: Remnants of R'lyeh
en.description: Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's Great Work. An ancient dark power is calling you and you need to find an exit. Face your greatest fear, fight, hide... you must escape before the underwater city rises...

en.name: Walled Haven
en.description: 《Walled Haven》An open world action-adventure set in the Walled City, a dystopian metropolis where Kung Fu decides all.

en.name: DownSouth
en.description: DownSouth is a moral-dilemma platformer RPG where your choices affect your sanity, and your sanity affects how you play.

en.name: Syncblade
en.description: A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.

upcoming.name: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!

en.name: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!
en.description: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement. Find thousands of scattered dice, identify their sets and return each one to the correct display. Play solo or in co-op, choose a fantasy class and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier.
